120: Cheta venafak ihu migginta deeden veavad toldot levar. la itkayymu bealma vela havi kedka chaze.

Amar rabbi chizkiyya veche hech yachlin lemebad toldot tamman deha illemale la itmeshich aleh yetzer hara vechata itkeyyaym ihu bealma bilchodoy vela yaavid toldot. kegavvna da illemale dechavu yisrael beegla veamshichu alayyhu yetzer hara la avadu (Bamidbar 189 1) toldot lealmin vela yetun darin ochoranin lealma.

Amar leh ilmale lo chata adam la avid toldot kegavvna da missitra deyetzer hara. aval avid toldot missitra derucha kaddisha. dehashta la avid toldot ella missitra deyetzer hara. uvegin dechol toldot divne nasha kulhu missitra deyetzer hara, begin kach let lon kiyyum. vei efshar lon leitkayyma, desitra ochora itarav behu. (15 33 veefshar lon besitra achara).

Aval illemale la chata adam vela ittarach migginta deeden. hava avid toldot missitra deruach kudesha dekaddishin kemalache illain kayymin ledare darin kegavvna dilela. kevan dechata veolid benin levar migginta deeden, vela zacha leappaka lon migginta, la itkayymu afillu leishterasha bealma da. ad deata noach deihu tzaddik veal batteva. umin teva nafku kol darin dealma. umittamman itbadderu lechol arba ruche alma. (shayych lekamman resh sav):

Vayyar elohim et haaretz vehinni nishchata. ammay nishchata. begin ki hishchit kol basar et darko, kema deittemar. rabbi chiyyay patach kera veamar (Yona 3:10) vayyar elohim et maasehem ki shavu middarkam haraa. ta chaze, beshaata divne nasha zachan venatre pikkude deorayyta, keden ara ittakfat, vechol chedu ishtakkechat bah. may tama begin dishchinta sharya al ara. ucheden kolla illae vetattae bechedva. vechad bene nasha mechabbelan archayyhu vela natre pekude orayyta vechatan kamme marihon, ucheden kivyachol dachyayn lah lishchinta mealma veishtearat ara mechabbela. deha shechinta itdachyay vela sharya alah ucheden itchabbelat. may taama itchabbelat. begin desharya rucha ochora alah dimchabbela alma. veal da amrinan deyisrael yahave oz lelohim dimkayymin alma. elohim da shechinta.

Veim chas veshalom i yisrael yishtakkechu chayyayvin ma ketiv, (tehillim 6) ruma al hashshamayim elohim vegomer mishshum dereshet hechinu lifamay. kafaf nafshi besivat chamas vesinat chinnam. karu lefanay shucha vegomer kegavvna dedor hammabbul divgin chamas dehavat benehon hava benehon sina udevavu.

Yachol af veara deyisrael ken. veha taninan ara deyisrael la sharya alah rucha ochora vela memanna ochora bar kudesha berich hu bilchodoy. ta chaze, deara deyisrael hachi hu dela sharya alah (84 amud bet) memanna vela shelicha ochora bar kudesha berich hu bilchodoy. aval shaata chada sharya alah lechabbela beni nasha. menalan middavid dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 21:16) vayyar david et malach Adonai vecharbo shelufa beyado netuya al yerushala 40 ucheden itchabbalat ara.

Amar rabbi elazar afillu behahi shaata kudesha berich hu hava. ketiv hacha malach Adonai. uchetiv hatam (Bereshit 48:16) hammalach haggoel oti. uchetiv (Shemot 14:19) vayyissa malach haelohim. hen letav vehen levish kudesha berich hu shallit alah. letav begin dela itmassera techot shear memannan, vechol dayyre alma yichsefun min ovadayyhu. levish begin dela yechodun innun leshaltaa alah.

Vei tema (davar acher 33 lo) veha ketiv, (Eicha 1:10) ki raata goyim bau mikdashah vecharivu beta vei lav shaltin innun memannan la itcharav makdesha. ta chaze, ketiv ki atta asita uchetiv asa Adonai et asher zamam.

Ta chaze, ketiv vayyar elohim et haaretz vehinne nishchata. nishchata vadday kema deittemar. hachi name (Yona 3:10) vayyar elohim et maasehem ki shavu middarkam haraa. deha keden ara karat leela vesalka bisliku illaa umekashta anpaha. kenukeva dimkashta legabbe dechura. hachi name ara. deha gedilat benin zakkain lemalka.

Vehacha dela tavu dara detofana ma ketiv vayyar elohim et haaretz vehinne nishchata vegomer keitteta deistaavat veastirat anpaha mibbaalah. uvezimna deasgiu chove beni nasha beitgalleya, ara shavvita anpaha kenukeva delet lah kissufa mikkolla kema deat amer, (yeshaya 22) vehaaretz chanfa tachat yoshveha. veal da vayyar ki nishchata vadday. may taama begin ki hishchit kol
121: Rabbi elazar azal legabbeh derabbi yose berabbi shimon ben lakonya chamoy. kevan dechama leh atkin leh tufesita (sefer acher tavepaseysea) dekumera bematun dekulefa vitivu. amar leh chamoy efshar deshamat meavuch hay dichtiv (Eicha 2:17) asa Adonai asher zamam bitztza emrato asher tziva mime kedem.

Amar leh ha ukemuha chavraya. bitztza emrato, devaza porpira dileh. asher tzivva mime kedem, deha porpira pakid lah meinnun yome kadmae illae, uveyoma deitchariv be makdesha baza lah. begin dehay porpira ihi yekara dileh vetikuna dileh uvaza leh.

Amar leh asa Adonai asher zamam. vechi malka chashiv (kodem) leavasha livnoy ad la yetun lemechte. amar leh lemalka dehava leh man yekar, uvechol yoma hava dachil aleh dela yitbar vehava mistakkel beh vetakkin beenoy. leyomin ata bereh veargiz leh lemalka, netal malka hahu man yekar utevar leh. hada hu dichtiv asa Adonai asher zamam.

Ta chaze, min yoma deitbene be makdesha hava kudesha berich hu mistakkel beh vechaviv aleh sagge vehava dachil alayyhu deyisrael deyechotun vicharev be makdesha. vechen bechol zimna dehava ate legabbe be makdesha hava lavish hahu porpira. levatar degarmu chovin veargizu kamme malka itcharav be makdesha uvaza hahu porpira (davar acher geris has hahu purepira veitcharav bi makdesha) hayenu dichtiv asa Adonai asher zamam.

Bitztza imrato vegomer (hay emrato bekadmita yatva berosh emir. veha itattaru itra leresha veilan nae lefanav. veihi mime kodam vadday. ucheden atzivu kammeh bevatte biri vadday vehen (Yeshayahu 33:7) erellam tzaaku chutza.

(Yeshayahu 22:12) Vayikra Adonai tzevaot beyom hahu vego) hayeynu bezimna deitchariv be makdesha. aval bezimna ochara let chedva kamme kudesha berich hu kezimna deitavidu chayyayve alma veinnun deargizu kammeh hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 11:10) uvaavod reshaim rinna. vechen bechol dara vedara deavid dina bechayyayve alma. chedva vetushebachta kamme kudesha berich hu.

Vei tema ha taninan delet chedva kamme kudesha berich hu kad ihu avid dina bechayyayvaya. ella ta chaze, beshaata deitavid dina bechayyayvaya, chedvavn vetushebchan kammeh al deitavidu mealma. vehanne mile kad mata hahu zimna (113 2, 121 2) deorich lon vela tavan legabbeh mechovayyhu. aval i itavid behu dina ad la mata zimnayyhu, (vead dela ishtelim chovayyhu, kema deat amar, 1) ki lo shalem avon haemori ad henna, keden let chedva kameh uvaish kammeh al deitavidu.

Vei tema ihu ad la matu zimnayyhu ammay avid behu dina. ella innun garmin bisha legarmayyhu. deha kudesha berich hu la avid behu dina ad la mata zimnayyhu. ella begin demishtattefe bahadayyhu deyisrael leavasha lon. uvegin kach avid behu dina veovid lon mealma bela zimna. veda hu deavish kammeh. uvegin kach atba mitzrae beyamma. veovid sanehon deyisrael bime yehoshafat. vechen kulhu. deha beginehon deyisrael itavidu bela zimna.

Aval kad ishtelim zimna deorich lon vela tavu. keden chedva vetushebachta kammeh al deitavidu mealma. bar bezimna deitchariv be makdesha. deaf al gav deishtelim zimna dilhon deargizu kammeh, la hava chedva kammeh. umehahu zimna la hava chedva leela vetatta:

Ki leyamim od shiva anochi mamtir al haaretz arbaim yom vearbaim layla vegomer. rabbi yehuda amar hani arbaim yom vearbaim layla may avidtayyhu. ella arbaim yom lealkaa chayyayve alma uchetiv, (Devarim 25:3) arbaim yakkennu lo yosif, lokovel arba sitre alma lechol chad asara. begin debar nash mearba sitre alma itbere. veal da umachiti et kol hayekum. veitzterich arbaim lealkaa uleitmeche alma.
Rabbi yitzchak hava shechiach kammeh derabbi shimon amar leh hay kera (dekamre) dichtiv vattishshachet haaretz
122: Lifni haelohim. i bene nasha chatan ara bemma. amar leh begin dichtiv ki hishchit kol basar et darko kema deittemar. kegavvna da (Vayikra 18:25) vattitma haaretz vaefkod avonah aleha. ella bene nasha chatan vei tema ara bemma, ella ikkera deara bene nasha innun. veinnun mechabbelin ara vehi itchabbalat. ukera ochach dichtiv vayyar elohim et haaretz vehinne nishchata ki hishchit kol basar et darko al haaretz.

Ta chaze, kol chetoy devar nash kulhu chabbaluta dileh talyayn bitshuva. vecheta deoshid zara al ara umechabbela archeh veappik zara al ara, mechabbil leh umechabbil ara. vealeh ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:22) nichtam avonich lefanay. uchetiv beh (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurecha ra. bar bitshuva sagge. uchetiv, (Bereshit 38:7) vayhi er bechor yehuda ra beene Adonai vaymitehu Adonai veha ittemar.

Amar leh ammay dain kudesha berich hu alma bemaya vela beesha vela bemilla ochora. amar leh raza hu deha innun chabbilu archayyhu begin demayin ilain umayin tattain la itchabbaru dechar venukeva kedka yeut. uman illen mayyin illain bina. umayyin tattain malchut. hei illaa hei tattaa. vechad innun mechabbelin, istalak 16 dehu dechar, veishtaar hei beHei (umayin bemayin. man innun dechabbilu archayyhu, kegavvna da mayin dechurin venukeve. veal da itdanu bemayya bema deinnun chavu.

Umayin havo retichan ufashtu mashka minnayyhu kema dechabbilu archayyhu bemayin retichan. dina lekabbel dina. hada hu dichtiv) nivkeu kol mayeynot tehom rabba, ha mayin tattain. vaarubbot hashshamayim niftachu da mayin illain. mayin illain vetattain.

Rabbi chiyyay verabbi yehuda havu azle bearcha. umatu legabbe turin ravrevan veashkachu bene turaya garme bene nasha dehavu meinnun beni tofana. ufasu telat mea pesian begarma chada. tevavhu. amru hayeynu deamru chavrana deinnun la havu missetafe middina dekudesha berich hu kema dichtiv, (Iyov 21:14-15) vayyomru lael sur mimmennu vedaat derachecha lo chafatznu. ma avdu. havu setimin beraglayyhu mabbue tehoma. umayin nafkin retichan vela yachilu lemekam behu, ad dehavu nishmatin unefalu beara umayytin:

Vayyoled noach shelosha vanim vegomer. amar rabbi chiyyay lerabbi yehuda ta veema lach mille deshamana behay. metal levar nash deail lenukeva dimarya (davar acher ibba dimaha) bezimna chada. venafke teren o telata benin. (kol) chad mitparsha meochora bearchoy beovadoy. da zakkaa veda chayyayva veda benoni. uf hacha name telat kitre derucha azlin veshatan veitkelilan bitlat almin.

Ta chaze, nishmata nafkat veail ben ture piruda veitchabbar rucha benishmata. nachit letatta itchabbar nefesh beruach vechulhu (azle davar acher nachtin) umitchabberin da im da. amar rabbi yehuda nefesh veruach kelilan da im da. nishmeta sharya bearchoy devar nash. (vehay) vehi medora temira dela ityeyda atraha.

Ata bar nash leitdakkaa, mesayyin leh benishmeta kaddisha vedachan leh umekaddeshin leh veikre kadosh. la zacha vela ate leitdakkaa, teren dargin petichin deinnun nefesh veruach beh. nishmeta kaddisha let beh (siyyua dilella veda kefum archeh). vela od ella dei yistaav mesaavin leh. vesiyyua dilela aadiu mineh. mikkan ulehala kol chad lefum archeh.

Tosefta keture ramay, dekastore dehusetra (sefer acher dehahu sitra) anan petichan ayynin petichan udenin. kal min kalaya nachitt meela letatta. metabbar turin vtinnarin. man innun dechaman vela chaman. atimin udenin. setimin ayynin. la chaman vla shamin la yadin besuchletanu, chad dichlila bitteren begavvyyhu. dachyayn leh levar.
Innun mittedabbekan ven (sefer acher beh) beinnun tere, chad umana deumana la sharya (sefer acher shavvevyan) begavvavyyhu. la alin ben sippere kaddishin. kol innun deumana da la
123: Sharya begavavyyhu la ichtevu besippere dachranayay ittemchun misippera dechayye kema deat amer (Tehillim 69:29) yimmachu misepper chayyim veim tzaddikim al yikkattevu.

Vavy lon kad yippekun mehay alma vavy lon (lacheyyhaven). man yitteba lon kad yittemasrun bida deduma vytokdun benura dedalik vela yippekun minneh bar beresh yarche vshabbatte kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 66:23) vhaya midde chodesh bechadsho umidde shabbatt beshabbatto yavo chol basar lehishtachavott lepanay amar Adonai. levattar karoza devistar tzappon achriz alayyhu vamar (Tehillim 9:18) yashuvu reshaim lishola vegomer. kamma chavile terikin ittekanshu alayyhu bearba sitrin. esha melahata bege ben hinnom.

Telatt zimnin beyoma mittepakdan (sefer acher matevakedan). vela od ella bezimna deyisrael attivu bekol ram amen yehe shemeh rabba mevaracha, kudesha bericha hu ittemle rachamin vechayis al kolla. vramiz lemalacha dimmanna al tare degehinnom samerayal shemeh uttelatt mappetchan bideh uppetach telatt tarin devistar madbera vechaman nehora dehay alma. atta tenana denura vsattim orchin.

Keden telatt memannan dittechott yedayyhu telatt magroppin menashvan bidayyhu vattivu tenana leatterayyhu vravvchin lon shaatta uppalgutt shaatta. ulevattar tayyvin leeshayyhu. vechen telatt zimnin beyoma uvechol zimnin deamre yisrael amen yehe shemeh rabba mevaracha vechulei innun ravvchin lon. zakkain innun tzaddikayay deorchehon menahara behahu alma lechol sitrin kema deat amer, (Mishlei 4:18) vorach tzaddikim keor noga holecha vor ad nechon hayyom (74 kan leshon hattosefta):

Rabbi abba amar, baggehinnam it medorin al medorin tinyaynin telitain ad sheva. veha ukemuha chavrayay. vezakkain innun tzaddikaya deinnun mistammerin mechove chayyayvaya vela azle bearchayyhu vela mistaave behu. vechol man deistaav kad azil lehahu alma, nachit laggehinnom. venachit ad medora tattaa.

Uteren medorin innun dismichin da im da sheol vaavaddon. man denachit lishol dayynin leh tamman umekabbel ansheh useliku leh limdora ochora illaa. vechen darga batar darga ad deinnun salkin leh. aval man denachit laavaddon la salkin leh lealmin. uvegin kach ikre avaddon deha avid hu mikkolla.

Ta chaze noach zakkaa, hava atre bivne dareh vela havu shame leh. ad dekudesha berich hu ayyte alayyhu dina degehinnom. may dina degehinnom esha vetalga. mayay veesha. da tzenina veda reticha. vechulhu bedina degehinnom itdanu veitavidu mealma.

Ulevatar itkeyyaym alma kedka chaze leh. veal noach batteva veail bah kol zina vezina (davar acher maberayyn) dealma. vadday noach etz ose peri hava. venafku min teva kol zeyayne alma kegavvna dilela.

Ta chaze, kad hay etz ose peri itchabbar beetz peri kol innun zayynin dilela chevavn ravrevan uzeeran vechamma zayynin vechol chad lezineh kema deat amer, (Tehillim 104:25) chayyot ketannot im gedolot. kegavvna da noach batteva. vechulhu nafku min tevuta veitkeyyaym alma kegavvna dilela. uvegine chach noach ish haadama ikre. noach ish tzaddik ikre veha ukemuha.

Rabbi chiyyay amar telat mea shenin ad la ate tofana hava noach atre behu al ovadehon vela havu shamin leh. ad dekudesha berich hu ashlim zimna deorich lon veitavidu mealma. ta chaze, ma ketiv leela vayhi ki hechel haadam larov al pene haadama uvanot yuldu lahem. vehavu azlin artilain leenehon decholla. ma ketiv, (Bereshit 6:2) vayyiru bene haelohim et benot haadam vegomer. veda hava yesoda veikkara lemegad bechovehon ad degarim lon leishtetzaa mealma. uvegin kach itmashchan batar yetzer hara uvegizoy vesharshoy. vedachu mehemnuta kaddisha mibbenayyhu. veistaavu (nusach acher vaayteabeydev) kema deittemar. begin kach ketz kol basar ba lefanay, laalafa kategorya alayyhu:

Vayyomer elohim el noach ketz kol basar ba lefanay. (ahadarna lemilla kadmaa ketz kol basar ba lifne. ba lifne vadday begin deinnun garmu). rabbi yehuda patach (Tehillim 39:5) hodieni Adonai kitztzi umiddat yamay ma hi eda me chadel ani. amar (leel ned 1) david kamme kudesha berich hu, teren kitztzin innun, chad leyamina vechad lismala, veinnun teren orchin lemehach behu bene nasha lehahu alma. ketz leyamina dichtiv, (Daniel 12) leketz hayyamin, veketz lismala dichtiv, (Iyov 28:3) ketz sam lachoshech ulechol tachlit hu choker (even avepal vetzalmavet. may ulechol tachlit hu choker, man hu choker. ella hahu ketz lismala demachshich appehon divriyyayta) may ulechol tachlit, bezimna dedina sharya al alma leshetzaa even ofel vetzalmavet. ketz sam lachoshech. da malach hamavet, da nachash, ketz kol basar, ketz sam lachoshech, deha misitra dehittucha dedahava kaate. ulechol tachlit bezimna dedina sharya al alma hu choker lemehve kategorya lealma leachshacha appehon dibberayyta vechulei.
124: Ketz leyamina kidkaamaran dichtiv leketz hayyamin. amar leh kudesha berich hu ledaniyyel veatta lech lakketz vetanuach. amar leh menucha behay alma o behahu alma, amar leh behahu alma kema deat amer yanuchu al mishkevotam. (Daniel 12:13) (vattaamod lagevarelach leketz hayyamin. ameraz leh lean atar deha lo yedana ma yehe alay behahu alma. amar leh vetanuach). amar leh bezimna dikumun meafra ekum benayyhu o lav. amar leh vetaamod. amar leh ha yedana di yekumun kittot kittot, minnehon dezakkae keshot uminnehon dechayyayve alma, vela yedana im man minnehon ekum. amar leh legoralcha. amar leh ha amart veatta lech lakketz. it ketz leyamina veit ketz lismala, vela yedana lean ketz. leketz hayyamin o leketz hayyamim. amar leh leketz hayyamin.

Uf hacha david amar leh lekudesha berich hu (Tehillim 39:5) hodieni Adonai kitztzi. ma ihu chulak advi. vela nach dateh ad deitbassar deyehve leyamina dichtiv, (Tehillim 110:1) shev limini. ta chaze, uf kudesha berich hu amar leh lenoach ketz kol basar ba lefanay. man ihu. da ketz deachshach appayyhu divriyyayta deihu ketz kol basar

Ba lefanay. mikkan olifna chayyayve alma makdimin leh umashchan leh alayyhu leachshacha lon. dechevan deyahave leh reshuta natil nishmata. vela natil ad deyahave leh reshuta. veal da ba lefanay lemetal reshu leachshacha appayyhu divne alma. uvegine chach vehinneni mashchitam et haaretz. veal da ase lecha tevat atze gofer begin leishtezava vela yachil leshaltaa alach.

Ta chaze, taninan bezimna demota it bemata o bealma (nusach acher deityeyhiv reshu lammalach hammavet lechabbala). la yitchaze bar nash beshuka. begin deit leh reshu limchabbela lechabbala kolla. begine chach amar leh kudesha berich hu bae lach leistamra vela techoze garmach kamme dimchabbela dela yishlot alach.

Vei tema man yahiv hacha mechabbela. deha mayin havu veitgabbaru. ta chaze, let lach dina bealma o kad itmache o kad itmasar alma bedina, dela ishtechach hahu mechabbela deazil bego innun dinin deitavidu bealma. uf hachi hacha tofana hava, umechabbela azil bego tofana. veihu ikre hachi deitkelil bishma da. veal da amar kudesha berich hu lenoach letamra garmeh vela yitchaze bealma.

Vei tema hay tevuta itchaze bego hay alma umechabbela azil begavvevy. kol zimna dela yitchaze appe debar nash kamme mechabbela la yachil leshaltaa aleh. menalan mimmitzrayim dichtiv, (Shemot 12:22) veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker. may tama begin deihu ishtekach veyachil hu lechabbela. velo itzterich leitchazzaa kammeh. begin kach hava ganiz noach vechol innun deimmeh betevuta. umechabbela la yachil leshaltaa alayyhu:

Rabbi chiyyay verabbi yose havu azle bearcha. iara behanne ture dekardu, chamu reshimin bekiin bearcha dehavu min yome detofana. amar leh rabbi chiyyay lerabbi yose hanne bekiin dehavu miyyomoy detofana, vekudesha berich hu shavik lon ledare darin begin dela yitmache chovehon derashshiaya kammeh.

Dechacha archoy dekudesha berich hu. lezakkain deavdin reuteh, bae deyidkerun lehu leela vetatta vela yitneshe ducheranehon ledare darin letav. kegavvna da lerashshiayay dela avdin reuteh, begin dela yitneshe chovayyhu uleadkara anshayyhu vedachranehon levish ledare darin. hayeynu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:22) nichtam avonech lefanay vegomer.

Patach rabbi yose veamar (Yeshayahu 10:30) tzahali kolech bat gallim hakeshivi laysha aniyya anatot. hay kera ukemuha chavraya. aval hay kera al keneset yisrael ittemar. tzahali kolech bat gallim, beratteh deavraham avinu hachi ukemuha bat gallim kedichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:12) gal naul. gallim innun nehorin demitkanshe veazle vealin legavvav umalyayn lah kedichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:13) shelachayich pardes rimmonim.

Hakeshivi laysha kema deat amer (Iyov 4:11) layish oved mibbeli teref. layish dechar. laysha nukeva. ammay ikre layish, i mishshum (Mishlei 30:30) dichtiv layish gibbor babbehema, o mishshum dichtiv layish oved mibbeli taref. ella kolla ihu layish gevura tattaa udeate miggevura illaa. layish oved mibbeli taref, beshaata deinnun nechalin mistalkin vela alin legavvav, keden itkere laysha deavidat mibbeli teref. dichtiv layish oved mibbeli
125: Uma deamar laysha hayeynu aniyya anatot missekena demiskenuta kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 1:1) min hakkohanim asher baanatot uchetiv, (Melachim 1 2:26) anatot lech al sadecha. may irya. ella kol zimna dedavid malka hava kayyaym, istallak evyatar beutera uvecholla. levatar amar leh shelomo anatot lech al sadecha.

Ammay kare leh shelomo hachi. ella amar leh beyomach hava abba bemiskenu vehasheta lech al sadecha. hasheta it lomar ammay ikre evyatar anatot. i tema dehava min anatot, ha taninan dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 22:20) vayyimmalet ben echad laachimelech ben achituv ushemo evyatar. vehu minnov hava, deha nov ir hakkohanim hava. veaf al pi deamru dehi nov hi anatot veammay lah ikre anatot begin denachatat lemiskenu veitavid karta al yeda deshaul veitavidu kahani. ella anatot kefar hava, velav hu nov, veal da kare leh evyatar anatot, begin deamar (Melachim 1 2:26) vechi hitannita bechol asher hitanna avi. umikkarta denov hava, veal miskenu dedavid dehava beyomoy ikre leh hachi.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bemiskenuta hava alma miyyoma deavar adam al pikkude kudesha berich hu, ad deata noach vekariv karban veityeyshav alma. amar rabbi yose la ityeyshav alma vela nafka ara mizzuhama denachash ad dekayymu yisrael al tura desinay veitachidu beilana dechayye keden ityeyshav alma.

Veilmale dehadru yisrael vechavu kammeh kudesha berich hu la havu metin lealmin. deha itpassak minnayyhu zuhama denachash. kevan dechavu keden itbaru innun luche kadmae, dehavu behu cheru decholla. cheru dehahu nachash deihu ketz kol basar.

Vechad kamu levae lekatla ketala, keden itar chivya bisha vehava azil kammayyhu vela yachil leshaltaa behu, begin dehavu yisrael mizdarzin kulhu bechagiru mezayynan vela yachil hahu nachash leshaltaa behu. vechevan deamar lemoshe (Shemot 33:5) veatta hored edyecha mealecha, ityeyhiv reshu lehay nachash leshaltaa alayyhu.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Shemot 33:6) vayyitnatztzelu bene yisrael et edyam mehar chorev. vayyitnatztzelu vaynatztzelu mibbae leh. ella vayyitnatztzelu al yeda deachara begin deityeyhiv reshu lenachash leshaltaa. et edyam mehar chorev dekibbelu mittura dechorev kad ityeyhiv orayyta leyisrael.

Amar rabbi chiyyay noach dehava tzaddik ammay la hava batil mota mealma. ella begin dead la salkat zuhama mealma. veod deinnun la havu mehemnin beh bekudesha berich hu vechulhu achidan betarpe ilana letatta umitlabbeshan beruach mesoova.

Vetu levatar osfu lemechote ulemehach batar yetzer hara kad bekadmita: veorayyta kaddisha deihi ilana dechayye akkatte la nachit lah kudesha berich hu beara. vetu deihu amshich leh bealma levatar dichtiv vayyesht min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal betoch oholo veha ittemar.

Ad dehavu azle, chamu chad yuday dehava ate. amar rabbi yose hay bar nash yuday ihu veitchaze. kad mata gabbayyhu sheilu leh. amar lon shelicha demitzva ana. deha anan dayyre bichfar deramin, umate zimna dechag, veanan tzerichin lulav vezinin deimmeh, veana azil lekata lon lemitzva. azlu kechada.

Amar lehu hahu yuday hanni arba minin delulav debchulho atan leratzuye alma (nusach acher al mayya) shematun ammay anan tzerichin lon bachag. amar leh kevar itaru behu chavrayay. aval i milla chadta ihu techot yedach ema lah.

Amar lon vadday hahu atar deanan dayyre beh hu zeer vechulhu aske beorayyta. veit alan tzureva merabbanan rabbi yitzchak bar yose mechozaa shemeh. uvechol yoma veyoma amar lan millin chadtin beorayyta. veamar deha bechag zimna hu leshaltaa. (yisrael shallitin behahu zimna, vanekaytanea lulav demitchaze deanan natzeychenaa alayyhu al kol innun deikrun hamem haam uleshalletaa alayyhu) (azay avar al nafshenu hammayim hazzedonim baruch Adonai shello netananu teref lishnehem. vechi it shenayim lammayim, ella) (sefer acher dechol innun ravrevin) innun shear ammin. innun ravrevin memannan al shear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot umitbarchan missitrayyhu deyisrael vekarinan lon mayim hazzedonim. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 124:5) hammayim hazzedonim.
Uvegin leshaltaa alayyhu atena beraza dishma kaddisha beinnun arba minin shebballulav leratztzuye leh lekudesha berich hu (alayyhu) uleshaltaa
126: Alayyhu beraza dishma kaddisha. uleatara alan mayin kaddishin lenascha al gabbe madbecha.

Tu amar lon berosh hashshana itaruta kadmaa ihu bealma. may itaruta kadmaa. da be dina diltatta (nusach acher da rosh hashshana mammash) deitar lemedan alma. vekudesha berich hu yativ al alma bedina vedain alma.

Veshalta hay be dina lemedan alma, ad yoma dechippure denaharin anpaha, vela ishtechach chivya daltora bealma. deihu itassak bame deatyayn leh hahu sair deihu missitra deruach mesoova kedka chaze leh. uvegin deitassak behahu sair la kariv lemakdesha.

Vesair da kehahu sair derosh chodesh deitassak beh veanhiru anpaha derosh hashana (nusach acher kach berosh hashshana) (nusach acher anhiru) (anpoy demakdesha). veal da yisrael kulhu mashkechin rachame kamme kudesha berich hu veitavar chovayyhu. veraza chada amar lon vela ityeyhiv reshu legallaa bar lechaside kaddishin elyonin chakkimin. amar rabbi yose man ihu. amar lon ad la badikna bechu.

Azlu. levatar amar lon. kad sihara itkerivat beshimsha. atar kudesha berich hu sitra detzafon veachid bah birchimu umashich lah legabbeh, vedarom itar missitra ochora. vesihara salka umitchabbera bemizrach. ucheden yanka mitteren sitrin unetilat birchan bachashay, ucheden itbarcha sihara veitmalyay. vehacha itkerivat itteta bevaalah.

Kema deit raza diukena shayyfe (nusach acher bateykevaney deshayyfe) deadam vetikkunoy. hachi name it (nusach acher ihu) raza dediukena deshayyfe nukeva vetikkuni denukeva. vecholla parish begavavn. hachi name it leela (davar acher man) achid bah veitar lokovel birchimu hachi name it letatta raza vetikkuna deadam tattaa ochora techot sihara (davar acher vetikkuna denukeba).

Kema didroa semala (tissa 194 2, pikkude 233 2) leela achid bah veitar lekovlah birchimu. hachi name it letatta. (vavy haammudim kullehu kayyme shayyfin leitachada da beda uleitkeshshera da beda kishre mehemanuta sitra dikdushsha missitra deruach misava deihu raza denachash letatta). hay nachash ihu deroa semala deruach mesoova. veachid beh man derachiv beh vekarava legabbe desihara umashich lah benayyhu nusach acher bidviku dekutefa veistoovat.
Ucheden yisrael letatta mekarvin sair. vehahu nachash itmeshach avatreh dehahu sair. vesihara itdechiat vesalkat leela veitkkesharat leela leitbarcha. unehirin anpaha ma deitchashchat letatta.

Keden hacha beyoma dechippure kevan dehahu chivya bisha itassak behahu sair. sihara itparshat minneh veitassekat (beyisrael) leolafa alayyhu sanegorya vesochechet alayyhu keimma al benin. vekudesha berich hu barich lon milleela umachil lon.

Levatar yisrael kad matu lachag mitare sitra deyamina leela. begin deyitkashshar beh sihara veyitnehiru anpaha kedka chaze. ucheden palgat (yahev) chulaka devirchan lechol innun memannan diltatta deyitassekun bechulakhon. vela yetun leyanka ulekarava besitra dechulakhon deyisrael.

Kegavvna da letatta kad shear amin itbarchun. kulhon innun mitassekin beachsanat chulakhon. vela havu atyayn leitarva bahadayyhu deyisrael ulechamda chulak achsantehon. uvegin kach yisrael innun mashchin birchan lechol innun memannan begin deyitassekun bechulakhon vela yitarvun bahadayyhu.

Vechad sihara itmele birchan leela kedka yeut. yisrael atyayn veyankin minnah bilchodayyhu. veal da ketiv (Bamidbar 29:35) bayyom hashshemini atzeret tihye lachem. may atzeret, ketargumo kenishu. kol ma dichnishu meinnun birchan illain. la yankin minneh ammin ochoranin bar yisrael bilchodayyhu. uvegin kach ketiv atzeret tihye lachem. lachem vela lishar ammin. lachem vela lishar memannan.

Veal da innun meratztzin al hammayim lemehav lon chulak birchan deyitassekun beh. vela yitarvun levatar bechedvavta deyisrael kad yankin birchan illain. veal hahu yoma ketiv dodi li vaani lo. dela itarav ochara bahadan.
Lemalka dezamman rechimoy bisudata illaa deavid leh leyoma reshima. ha rechimoy demalka yeda demalka
127: Itrae beh. amar malka hasheta ana bae lemechede im rechimay. vedachilna dechad ana bisudata im rechimay yaalun kol innun kastore memannan vitivun immana liftora lemisad seudata dechedva im rechimay. ma avad akdim hahu rechimoy kuseturin diroke uvisra detore veakriv kammayyhu deinnun kasture memannan lemechal. levatar yativ malka im rechimoy lehahi seudata illaa mikkol iddunin dealma. uveod deihu bilchodoy im malka shail leh kol tzarkoy veyahiv leh. veachade malka im rechimoy bilchodohi vela itarvin ochoranin benayyhu. kach yisrael im kudesha berich hu. begin kach ketiv bayyom hashshemini atzeret tihye lachem.

Amru rabbi yose verabbi chiyyay kudesha berich hu atkin orcha kamman. zakkain innun demishtaddele beorayyta. ate neshakuhu. kara aleh rabbi yose (Yeshayahu 54:13) vechol banayich limmude Adonai verav shelom banayich. kad matu be chakal yativu. amar hahu bar nash may shena dichtiv, (Bereshit 19:24) vaAdonai himtir al sedom veal amora vegomer. (nidpas befikkude 227 2) umay shena betofana dichtiv elohim elohim bechol atar. (amay) vela ketiv vaAdonai (becholla).

Ella taninan bechol atar dichtiv vaAdonai hu uvet dino. elohim setam dina bilchodoy. ella bisdom itavid dina vela leshetzaa alma. uvegin kach itarev ihu bahade dina. aval betofana kol alma shatze vechol innun deishtakkachu (nusach acher bilchodoy) bealma.

Vei tema (davar acher deha) noach udeimmeh (davar acher ishtezivu). (nusach acher ha) satim maayana hava dela itchaze. veal da kol ma deishtechach bealma shatze leh. veal da vaAdonai beitgalya vela shatze cholla. elohim bae setimu uvae leistammera deha kolla shatze. veal da elohim bilchodoy have.

Veraza da (Tehillim 29:10) Adonai lammabbul yashav. mahu yashav. ilmale kera ketiv la yachlinan lememar. yashav bilchodoy dela atya im dina. ketiv hacha yashav, uchetiv hatam (Vayikra 13:46) badad yeshev bilchodoy.
Uvegin denoach hava satim maayana. levatar kad itavid dina veshatze alma venach rugezeh ma ketiv vayyizkor elohim et noach vegomer. deha kad shatze alma la idkar desatim maayana hava.

Veraza (veda) olifna kudesha berich hu satim vegalya. galya hu be dina diltatta. satim hu atar dechol birchan nafke mittamman. uvegin kach kol milloy devar nash deinnun bistimu birchan sharyayn aloy. vechol deinnun beitgalleya hahu atar deve dina sharyan aloy begin deihu atar beitgele vehahu deikre ra ayin shallit aleh, vecholla hu beraza illaa kegavvna dilela.

Bacha rabbi yose veamar zakkaa dara derabbi shimon sharya begavveh deha zechuta dileh azmin lan beture millin illain keillen (74 kan). amar rabbi yose hay bar nash leodaa lan millin illen ka ate veshadreh kudesha berich hu legabban. kad atu vesidderu millin kammeh derabbi shimon amar vadday shappir ka amar.

(Nidpas befikkude 268 2)rabbi elazar hava yativ yoma chad kammeh derabbi shimon avuy. amar leh hay ketz kol basar ithanne meinnun karbanin dehavu yisrael mekarvin al gabbe madbecha o la. amar leh kolla havu mistappeke kechada leela vetatta.

Veta chaze kahani velevae veyisrael innun ikrun adam bechibbura deinnun reutin kaddishin desalkin miggavavyyhu. hahu kisba o imra o hahi behema dekarvin itzterich ad la yitkeriv al gabbe madbecha lefarasha alah kol chattain vechol reutin bishin leitvaddaa alah. ucheden hahi itkere behema becholla bego innun chattain uvishin vehirhurin.

Kegavvna dekarbana daazazel dichtiv (Vayikra 16:21) vehitvadda alav et kol avonot bene yisrael vegomer. hachi name hacha. vechad salka al gabbe madbecha metula al chad teren. uvegin kach da salka leatreh. veda salka leatreh. da beraza deadam veda beraza divhema kema deat amer (Tehillim 36:7) adam uvehema toshia Adonai.

Chavitin vechol shear menachot leatara rucha kaddisha biruta dechahane veshirata delevae uvitzlota deyisrael. uvehahu tenana veshamna vekimcha desalik mitravvavn umistappekin (sefer acher vametapenakeyn) (sefer acher umitpashshetin)
128: Kol shear mare dedinin dela yachlin leshaltaa behahu dina deitmasar lon. vecholla bezimna chada. ta chaze, kolla itavid beraza dimhemnuta leistappeka da beda, uleistallaka leela man deitzterich ad en sof.

(Nidpas befikkude 221 1, 268 2) amar rabbi shimon aremat yeday bitzlotin leela, dechad reuta illaa leela leela kayyma al hahu reuta dela ityeda velo itpas kelal lealmin resha desatim yattir leela. vehahu resha appik may deappik vela yedia venahir may denahir kolla bistimu.

Reo demachashava illaa lemirdaf avatreh uleitnehara minneh. chad perisu itperis. umiggo hahu perisa birdifu dehahi machashava illaa mate vela mate ad hahu perisa nahir ma denahir. ucheden (sefer acher hahu) ihu machashava illaa nahir binhiru (bistimu) satim dela yedia vehahu machashava la yada.

Keden batash hay nehiru demachashava dela ityeyda binhiru defarsa dekayyma denahir mimma dela yedia vela ityeyda vela itgalyay. ucheden (nusach acher hay) da nehiru demachashava dela ityeyda batash binhiru difrisa venaharin kechada veitavidu tesha hechalin.

Vehechalin lav innun nehorin velav innun ruchin velav innun nishmatin. vela it (ihu) man dekayyma behu. reuta dechol tesha nehorin dekayyme kulhu bemachashava deihu chad minnayyhu bechushebna kulhu lemirdaf batrayyhu beshaata dekayyme bemachashava vela mitdabbekan vela ityeydau. veillen la kayyme la biruta vela bemachashava illaa (nusach acher illain). tafsin bah vela tafsin. beillen kayyme kol raze dimhemnuta vechol innun nehorin meraza demachashava illaa (diltatta davar acher uletatta) kulhu ikrun en sof. ad hacha matu nehorin vela matun vela ityeydau. lav hacha reuta vela machashava.
(Keden davar acher kad) nahir machashava vela ityeyda (yedia) mimman denahir. keden itlabbesh veastim go bina venahir leman denahir veail da beda ad deitkelilu kulhu kechada.

Uveraza dekarbana kad salik kolla itkashshar da beda venahir da beda. keden kayyme kulhu bisliku umachashava itattar been sof. hahu nehiru deitnehir minneh machashava illaa (dela ityeyda bah kelal) ikre en sof. uminneh ishtechach vekayyma venahir leman denahir veal da kolla kaim. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikaya bealma den uvealma deate.
Ta chaze, hay ketz kol basar, kema dekishshura ishtechach leela bechedu, uf hachi name letatta bechedvevta. ureuta leistappeka kolla leela vetatta. veimma kayyma alayyhu deyisrael kedka yeut.

Ta chaze, bechol reshe yarcha veyarcha kad sihara mitchaddesha yahavin leh lehay ketz kol basar chuleka chada yattir al karbanin leitaska beh veyishtammesh bechulakeh. vihe sitra deyisrael bilchodayyhu. begin deyitachadun bemalchehon, veda ihu sair. begin deihu bechulaka deesav dichtiv beh sair (Bereshit 27:11) hen esav achi ish sair. veal da ihu ishtammash bechulakeh. veyisrael innun mishtammeshin bechulakehon. uvegin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 135:4) ki yaakov bachar lo yah yisrael lisgulato.

Ta chaze, hay ketz kol basar, kol reuteh lav ihu ella bevisra tadir uvegin kach tikkuna devisra tadir legabbeh veal da ikre ketz kol basar. vechad ihu shallit, shallit al gufa vela al nishmeta. nishmeta salka leatra uvisra ityehiv leatar da. kegavvna da bekarbana diruta salka leatar chad, uvisra leatar chad.

Ubbar nash deihu zakkaa ihu karbana mammash lechappara. veochora delav ihu zakkaa, lav ihu karbana begin deveh muma dichtiv, (Vayikra 22) ki lo leratzon vegomer. veal da tzaddikaya kappara innun dealma vekarbana innun bealma (74 kan): ta chaze, vayyomer elohim lenoach ketz kol basar ba lefanay. lemetal reshu leachshacha appayyhu
129: Divne alma. uvegine chach hinni mashchitam et haaretz. (veal da asa lecha tevat atze gavepar begin leishtezava bah velo yachil leshalletaa alach. rabbi chiyyay verabbi yose havo azle bearcha amar chad) ketiv vayaas noach kechol asher tzivahu Adonai.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv venoach ben shesh meot shana vegomer. vechi ammay ata chushebna da lemimne. ella ilu la hava noach ben shesh meot shana la yeul letevuta vela yitchabbar bahadah. kevan deishtallim beshesh meot shana keden itchabbar bahadah.

Veal da min yoma deishtallim chovayyhu divne alma orich lon kudesha berich hu ad deishtallim noach beshesh meot shana veishtallim dargeh kedka yeut vehava tzaddik shelim. ucheden al letevuta. vecholla kegavvna dilela: venoach ben shesh meot shana kema deamaran. uvegine chach la ittemar keven shesh meot shana. (davar acher 33 lokovel shit sitrin dealma). tu patach veamar vaani hinni mevi et hammabbul mayim. may tama hinni kevan deamar vaani. ella ani anochi (nusach acher hinni) kolla milla chada hi.

Ta chaze, bechol atar ani itavid gufa lenishmeta vadday dimkabbela mimma dilela. uvegin kach itremiz beat kayyayma dichtiv ani hinne beriti ittach. ani dekayyma beitgalleya mezumenet leminda. ani karseya lema dilela. ani deavidna nukemin ledare darin. vaani kalil dechar venukeva kechada. levatar itreshim bilchodoy deizdamman lemebad dina. hinni. mevi et hammabbul mayim.

Kevan deamar mevi et hammabbul la yedana deihu mayim. ela et hammabbul leasgaa malach hammavet, deaf al gav demaya havu. mechabbela (lechabbala behon mechabbela) (davar acher hava) azil bealma leshetzaa beinnun mayin.

Ani Adonai, hachi taninan neeman ana leshallema agar tav letzaddikayya uleitpara merashiayya. uvegin kach avtach lon kera letzaddikayya beani leshallema agar tav dilhon lealma deate. veagzim lerashiayya leitpera minnayyhu lealma deate beani.

Leshachet kol basar. kema deokimna deda hu mechabbela dealma. veal da ketiv, (Shemot 12:23) velo yitten hammashchit lavo el battechem lingof. veda hu leshachet kol basar missitra deketz kol basar ba lefanay. deha kevan demata zimna deorich lon kudesha berich hu (davar acher 33 veorich lon) ad deashlim noach leshesh meot shana keden leshachet kol basar. amar hachi olifna mishmeh derabbi yitzchak (sefer acher berabbi yose machevazeay) deamar lan (nusach acher hay deamre lechon).

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 38:11) amarti lo ere yah yah beeretz hachayyim lo abbit adam od im yoshve chadel. amarti lo ere yah, kamma atimin innun beni nasha dela yadin vela mashgichin bemille deorayyta, ella mistakkele bemilloy dealma veitneshe minnayyhu rucha dechachmeta.

Dechad bar nash istallak mehay alma veyahiv chushebna lemareh mikkol ma deavad behay alma beod deihu kaim rucha vegufa kechada vechame ma dechame, ad deazil lehahu alma ufaga leh leadam harishon yativ letara deginta deeden lemechome kol innun denatru pikkude demarehon vechade behu.

Vechamma tzaddikayya sochoraneh deadam. innun deitmenau mearcha degehinnom vesatu legabbe archa degan eden. veillen ikrun yoshve chadel. vela ketiv yoshve chaled. begin dela havu kemo chuleda degarra umancha vela yada leman shavka. ella yoshve chadel. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 2:22) chidlu lachem min haadam vegomer (ella yoshve chadal) deitmena lon mearcha degihinnom. veatkifu behu leaala lehu beginta deeden.

Davar acher yoshve chadel innun marehon ditshuva dimnau garmayyhu meinnun chovin dechayyayvaya. uvegin deadam harishon tav bityuveta kamme mareh. yativ (nusach acher im) al innun deitmenau mechovehon veinnun bene chadel. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 39:5) eda me chadel ani. uvegin kach ihu yativ letara deginta deeden vechade behu betzaddikayya deatyayn behahu orcha deginta deeden.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv amarti lo ere yah. vechi man yachil lemechome yah. ella sofa dikra ochach dichtiv yah beeretz hachayyim. ta chaze, kad (teruma kamma) salkin nishmatin leatar tzerora dechayye. tamman mithannan bezohora deaspaklarya denahara denahir
130: Meatar ilaa decholla. veilu la mitlabbesha nishmata bezahara dilvusha ochora la tichol leitkarava lemechome hahu nehora.

Veraza demilla kema deyahave lenishmata levusha demitlabbesha beh lemekam behay alma. hachi name yahave lah levusha dezahara illaa lemekam beh behahu alma uleistakkala bego hahu aspaklarya denahara miggo hahu eretz hachayyim.

Ta chaze, moshe la yachil lekarva leistakkela bamme deistakkal ella kad itlabbash bilvusha ochora kema deat amer (Shemot 24:18) vayyavo moshe betoch heanan vayyaal el hahar. vetargum bimtziut anana. veitlabbash bah keman deitlabbash bilvusha. uvegin da (Shemot 20:18) umoshe niggash el haarafel asher sham haelohim uchetiv, (Shemot 24:18) vayyavo moshe betoch heanan vegomer vayhi moshe bahar arbaim yom vearbaim layla veyachil leistakkala bamme deistakkal.

Kegavvna da mitlabbeshin nishmathon detzaddikaya behahu alma bilvusha kegavvna dehahu alma dela yitnaheg ella bilvusha kegavvna da vekayyme leistakkala binhora denahir behahu eretz hachayyim. vezehu yah yah beeretz hachayyim. dehava savir dela yizke lehahu nehora ulehahu istakkeluta begin denahara denagid pasik leh vela olid. lo abbit adam od da adam kadmaa kema deittemar.

Vechol da lamma. begin deamar leh nevia ki met atta behay alma vela tichye lehahu alma. begin. deman dela (hava) olid benin behay alma, kad nafik minneh metarchin leh michol ma deamaran. vela sharya lemechome behahu nehora denahir (kol shekken vechol shekken shear amma ushear bene nasha). uma chizkiyya dehava leh zechut avot veihu zakkaa tzaddik vachasida kach. kol shekken man delet leh zechut avot vechate kamme mareh.

Hay levusha dekaamaran ihu (innun) ma deamru chavrayay chaluka derabbanan deitlevishu behahu alma. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay deganiz lon kudesha berich hu kamma tavin veidunin lehahu alma, alayyhu ketiv, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin la raata elohim zulatecha yaase limchakke lo:

Vaani hinni mevi et hammabbul mayim al haaretz. rabbi yehuda patach (Bamidbar 20:13) hemma me meriva asher ravu bene yisrael et Adonai vayyikkadesh bam. vechi beatar ochora lo ravu bene yisrael et Adonai. may shena hacha dekaamar hemma me meriva vela ochoranin. ella hanne me meriva havu vadday deyahavu chela vetukefa lemarehon dedina leittakfa. begin deit mayin metukin veit mayin meriran. it mayin tzelilan veit mayin achiran. it mayin shelam veit mayin ketatu. veal da hemma me meriva asher ravu bene yisrael et Adonai, deamshichu alayyhu leman dela itzterich veisteivu beh hada hu dichtiv vayyikk1dish bam.

Amar leh rabbi chizkiya i hachi may vayyikkadesh vayyikkadeshu mibbae leh. ella milla istelikat. vayyikkadesh itpegim man dela itzterich. kivyachol deitpegemat sihara. vayyikkaddesh lav leshivcha ihu hacha. vaani hinni mevi et hammabbul kema deokimna leayytaa mechabbela alayyhu kema deinnun isteavu beh.

Amar rabbi yose vavy lon lerashshiaya dela baan leatava kamme kudesha berich hu al chovehon beod deinnun behay alma. dechad bar nash ativ veitnecham al chovoy. kudesha berich hu machil leh. vechol innun demittakfin bechovayyhu vela bau leatava kamme kudesha berich hu al (chovoy) chovehon. levatar (yinpol) yinpelu legehinnom vela yiskun leh mittamman lealmin.

Ta chaze, begin deatkifu libbayyhu kol innun dara denoach uvau leachazaa chovayyhu beitgalya. kudesha berich hu ayyte dina alayyhu behahu gavvna. amar rabbi yitzchak veafillu kad chate bar nash veitkasya kudesha berich hu rachaman. vei tav bar nash legabbeh chafe aleh umachil leh veshavik leh. vei la, gale leh leene cholla. menalan missota.

Vehachi name itmechun illen chayyayvaya meara beitgalya. vehech itmechun. ella dehavu nafke mayay vehavu retichan min tehoma vesalke veaavar minnayyhu mashcha. vechevan deaavar minnayyhu mashcha hachi name bisra vela ishtearu ella begarmayyhu lechod. lekayyma dichtiv vayyimmachu min haaretz. vechol innun garme itpardan da min da vela ishtaaru kechada. umikkola itavaru mealma. rabbi yitzchak amar vayyimmachu min haaretz, may vayyimmachu, kema deat amer yimmachu missefer chayyim. mikkan olifna delet lon techiyya lealmin vela yekumun bedina.
131: Vahakimoti et beriti ittach. amar rabbi elazar mehacha kiyyuma divrit leela kekiuma divrit letatta. mashma dichtiv ittach. veamar rabbi elazar mikkan olifna dechad zakkain innun bealma itkeyyaym alma leela vetatta. amar rabbi shimon milla satim ihu. kad itaruta didchura legabbe nukeva kad ihu mekanne lah.

Ta chaze, raza demilla kad tzaddika ihu bealma miyyad shechinta la itadiat minneh vetiuveta dilah beh. keden tiuveta dilela legabbah birchimu ketiuveta didchura lenukeveh kad ihu mekanni lah. veal da vahakimoti et beriti ittach. itar tiuveta beginach. kegavvna da (Bereshit 17:21) veet beriti akim et yitzchak.

Vahakimoti et beriti ittach lemeheve at beriti bealma. ulevatar uvata el hatteva, deilmale lav ihu tzaddik (berit) la yeul letevuta deha la itchabbar latteva bar tzaddik, uvegine chach uvata el hatteva veha ittemar.

Amar rabbi elazar bechol zimna divne nasha yitachadun bivrit da, vela yishbekun leh, let am velishan bealma deyechul leavasha lon. venoach atkif bivrit da venatar leh, begine chach kudesha berich hu natar leh (vechol dileh). vechol beni dareh la natru leh, begin kach kudesha berich hu aavar lon mealma. veha ittemar behahu chova mammash deinnun chavu behahu gavvna itmechun mealma.

Rabbi yehuda hava shechiach kammeh derabbi shimon, vehavu aske behay kera dichtiv, (Melachim 1 18:30) vayrappe et mizbach Adonai heharus. may vayrappe. ta chaze, bime eliyyahu, yisrael kulhu shavku leh lekudesha berich hu veshavku berit kayyayma dilhon. kad ata eliyyahu vechama deka shavku bene yisrael hay berit kayyayma veaavaru minnayyhu hay berit.

Kevan dechama eliyyahu chach ata leatkana milla leducheteh. kevan dekariv milla leducheteh ittese kolla. hada hu dichtiv vayrappe et mizbach Adonai heharus. da berit kayyayma (davar acher 33 deata leatkena mizbeach Adonai heharus berit kayyeyma) dehava shavik mealma. uchetiv, (Melachim 1 18:31) vayyikkach eliyyahu shetem esre avanim lemispar shivte bene yaakov. da hu tikkuna demizbach Adonai.

Asher haya devar Adonai elav lemor yisrael yihye shemecha. may tama idkar hacha yisrael, ella vadday yisrael yihye shemecha vadday leistallaka leela velatava berit kayyayma leatreh. vehayenu dichtiv ki azvu beritcha beni yisrael. uvegin kach et mizbechotecha harasu.

Ta chaze, kol zimna deyisrael natru keyayma kaddisha keden avde kiyyuma leela vetatta. vechad shavke lehay berit keden la ishtechach kiyyum leela vetatta dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti. uvegin kach vayrappe et mizbach Adonai heharus. vechi refua ihu. hachi hu vadday deha mekayyem lehahu atar dimhemnuta talya beh.

Ta chaze, uf hachi pinchas beshaata dekanne leovada dezimri atkin lehay berit beatreh. uvegin kach ketiv, (Bamidbar 25:12) hinni noten lo et beriti shalom. vechi salka datach divgin pinchas hava. uma ketata hava leh lefinchas behay berit. ella hacha itkeshar milla beducheteh. hinni noten lo et beriti. uma etten lo shalom (leitchabbera kol chad beducheteh) leitchabbera berit beatreh. veal da hinni noten lo et beriti (shalom). uma (nusach acher ihu) shalom deihu atreh leitchabbera bahadeh. ma deitparash minneh bechovayyhu. begineh itchabbar beh. veal da hoil vehu atkin milla beducheteh, mikkan ulehala vehayta lo ulezaro acharav berit kehunnat olam, tachat asher kinne lelohav vegomer.

Amar rabbi shimon let lach milla bealma dekudesha berich hu kanne lah kemo chova divrit kema deat amer, (Vayikra 26:25) cherev nokemet nekam berit. veta chaze, la ishtelim chova dedara detofana, ella begin dechavu bechabbilu (dearchayyhu) al ara. veaf al gav dehavu mekappeche da leda kedichtiv vattimmale haaretz chamas (vechamas mikkolla hava uvegin kach) uchetiv ki
132: Mala haaretz chamas mippenehem. mikkol makom vattishshachet haaretz lifne haelohim. vehinni mashchitam midda keneged midda, hinni mashchitam bechova dechabbaluta.

Veit deamre dela ishtelim kistayyhu ella bechova dechamas dehavu mekappechin da leda dehavu bishin lashshamayim velabberiyyot. ta chaze, kamma innun memannan milleela deitpakdan al kale deinnun demasre dina al chavrehon al ma deavde lon. veal da ketiv ki mala haaretz chamas mippenehem. uvegin kach ketiv vehinni mashchitam et haaretz:

Vayyomer Adonai lenoach bo atta vechol betcha. amar rabbi shimon ammay bechulhu (davar acher 33 amar) elohim vehacha Adonai. may shana hacha deittemar Adonai shema illaa derachame. ella raza ihu deolifna. lav orach ara lekabbela itteta ushepiza bahadah ella birshu devaalah.

Uf hachi (nammi noach) noach baa leaala betevuta leitchabbera bahadah. velav hava (leh) yaot ad devaalah deteva yahav leh reshu leaalaa (bahadah). dichtiv bo atta vechol betcha el hatteva. uvegin kach ikre hacha Adonai baalah deteva. ucheden al noach veitchabbar bahadah. vechen olifna delet leh reshu leushepiza lemeal leveta ella birshu baalah mareh deveta, hada hu dichtiv levatar vayyavo noach vegomer.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv ki otcha raiti tzaddik lefanay baddor hazze. mikkan olifna dela yekabbel bar nash ushepiza beveteh i ihu chashid beh deihu chayyayva. ella i kaim beenoy lezakkaa dela chashid beenoy kelal. hada hu dichtiv bo atta vechol betcha el hatteva, may tama begin ki otcha raiti tzaddik lefanay baddor hazze.

Veolifna dei yahiv leh reshu bilchodoy vela yahiv reshu lechol innun deatyayn immeh, la yeul lon leveta. hada hu dichtiv bo atta vechol betcha el hatteva. lechola yahiv reshuta lemeal. umikra da olifna raza dearchoy deara. (davar acher 33 ba atta vechol betecha el hatteva vegomer).

Rabbi yehuda patach (Tehillim 24:1) ledavid mizmor laAdonai haaretz umeloah tevel veyoshve vah. ha taninan ledavid mizmor deamar shirata ulevatar sharat aleh ruach kaddisha, mizmor ledavid desharat aleh ruach kaddisha ulevatar amar (la) shirata.

LaAdonai haaretz umeloah, hay kera al ara deyisrael ittemar deihi ara kaddisha. umeloah da shechinta kema deat amer, (divrei hayamim 2 Adonai:14) ki male chevod Adonai et bet Adonai. uchetiv, (Shemot 40:34) uchevod Adonai male et hammishkan. may male vela mila. ella male vadday deitmalyay mikkolla. deitmalyay min shimsha. sihara shelim bechol sitrin. male mikkol tuva dilela. keiskofa da deitmalyay mikkol tuva dealma. veal da ketiv laAdonai haaretz umeloah. tevel veyoshve vah da shear aran.

Davar acher laAdonai haaretz umeloah da ara kaddisha illaa dekudesha berich hu itrae vah. umeloah illen nishmathon detzaddikayyay (davar acher 33 dechallehon malyayn la) itmalyay (davar acher deitmalyay) minnayyhu mechela deammuda chad dealma kayyma aleh.
Vei tema al chad kayyma. ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Tehillim 24:2) ki hu al yammim yesadah. ki hu. man hu. da kudesha berich hu. kema deat amer hu asanu. uchetiv, (Iyov 28:24) ki hu liktzot haaretz yabbit.

Al yammim yesadah veal neharot yechonneha illen shiva ammudim dekayyma (ara) alayyhu umalyayn lah. hi itmalyay minnayyhu, hech itmalyay minnayyhu. beshaata deasgiu zakkain bealma keden ara da avdat perin veitmalyay mikkolla.

Uveshaata deasgiu chayyayvin bealma keden ketiv, (Iyov 14:11) azlu mayim minni yam venahar yechorav veyavesh. azlu mayim minni yam, da ara kaddisha deamaran deishtakya mishshakyu illaa. venahar yecherav veyavesh, hahu ammuda chad dekaim alah leitnahara minneh. venahar yecherav veyavesh kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzaddik avad.

Veamar rabbi yehuda behahu zimna deitavidu innun chayyavin mealma kudesha berich hu (atziv) (nusach acher istakkal) ishtadal al alma vela chama man (dekaim) deagin ola. vei tema ha noach, dehava leh leaggana al (dareh) garmeh uleafaka minneh toladin lealma. hada hu dichtiv ki otcha raiti tzaddik lefanay baddor hazze. baddor hazze dayyka.
133: Amar baddor hazze da shevacha dileh dehava behahu dara chayyayva veishtechach kule hay ish tzaddik tamim (vadday velav bedara dileh ella) (sefer acher veda di leh) veafillu bedara demoshe, aval la hava yachil leaggana al alma. begin dela ishtakkechu asara bealma kema deat amer, (Bereshit 18:29) ulay yimmatzun sham asara vela ishtakkechu tamman, uf hacha la ishtakkechu asara. ela hu utelat benoy venukevayyhu vela havu asara.

Rabbi elazar shail leh lerabbi shimon avoy, ha taninan beshaata dealma itmalyay chove bene nasha vedina nafak, vavy lehahu zakkaa deishtechach bealma deihu itpas bechovoy dechayayvaya bekadmita. noach ech ishteziv dela itpas bechovayyhu. amar leh ha ittemar dekudesha berich hu baa leafaka minneh toladin lealma miggo tevuta. vetu deha dina la yachla leshaltaa aloy begin dehava tamir veganiz batteva veitkasyay meena.
Veta chaze, ketiv, (Tzefanya 2:3) bakshu tzedek bakshu anava ulay tissatru beyom af Adonai. venoach bikkesh tzedek veal begavvav leshaltaa ulekatrega leh.
Hacha itremiz leinnun kaddishe elyonin leminda beraza deatvavn kaddishin illain hippucha deatvavn 22 leitmeche leinnun chayyayvaya. veal da vayyimmachu min haaretz ketiv. bo atta vechol betcha.

Rabbi yitzchak patach (Yeshayahu 63:12) molich limin moshe zeroa tifarto bokea mayim mippenehem laasot lo shem olam. (nusach acher zeroa tifarto) da zechuta deavraham deihu yamina mimmoshe. tiferet demoshe. uvegin kach bokea mayim mippenehem. deha zechuta deavraham bokea mayim ihu. vechol da lama laasot lo shem olam.

Ta chaze, ma ben moshe lishar bene alma. beshaata deamar lah kudesha berich hu lemoshe (Shemot 32:10) veatta hannicha li vegomer. veeese otcha legoy gadol vegomer. miyyad amar moshe vechi eshbok dinhon deyisrael begini. hasheta yemrun kol innun bene alma deana katlit lon leyisrael. kema deavad noach.

Dechevan deamar leh kudesha berich hu disheziv leh betevuta (kema deittemar) dichtiv vaani hinni mevi et hammabbul mayim vegomer. uchetiv umachiti et kol hayekum asher asiti meal pene haadama vaani hinni mekim et beriti vegomer uvata el hatteva kevan deamar leh deyishteziv hu uvenoy la baa rachamin al alma veitavidu. uvegin kach ikrun me hammabbul al shemeh kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 54:9) ki me noach zot li shor noshobbaatti moavor me noach.

Amar moshe hasheta yemrun beni alma deana ketilat lon begin deamar li veeese otcha legoy gadol. hasheta tav li deemut vela yishtetzun yisrael. miyyad vaychal moshe et pene Adonai elohav. baa rachamin alayyhu veitar rachame al alma.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak sheruta devaa rachame alayyhu may kaamar. lamma Adonai yechore appecha beammecha. vechi milla da ech amar leh moshe lamma. veha avadu kochavim umazzalot kema deat amer asu lahem egel masseche vayyishtachavu lo vayyomru elle vegomer. umoshe amar lamma. ella hachi olifna man dimratztze leochora la bae lemebad hahu chova (deihu) rav, ella yazir leh kammeh. ulevatar yasge leh kammeh ochora (davar acher 33 chayyayva) dichtiv attem chatatem chataa gedola.

Vela shavik leh lekudesha berich hu ad demasar garmeh lemota dichtiv veatta im tissa chatatam veim ayin mecheni na missifrecha asher katavta. vekudesha berich hu machil lon dichtiv vayyinnachem Adonai al haraa vegomer. venoach la avad ken ella baa leishtezava veshavik kol alma.

Uvechol zimna dedina sharya al alma, ruach kudesha amar vavy dela ishtechach kemoshe dichtiv (Yeshayahu 63:11) vayyizkor (yeme olam moshe immo) (vego) ayye hammaalem miyyam vegomer. dichtiv (Shemot 14:15) vayyomer Adonai el moshe ma titzak elay. deha ihu bitzlota salik lon min yamma. uvegin deshavve garmeh bitzlota alayyhu deyisrael beyamma. ikre (al shemeh) hammaalem miyyam. deihu assik lon min yamma.
Ayye hassam bekirbo et ruach kadsho da ihu moshe deashre
134: Shechinta benayyhu deyisrael. molicham battehomot kad itbaku maya veazlu bego tehome beyabbeshta diglidu maya (vecholla ittemar al moshe). (nusach acher veal da ikre moshe immo) begin deamsar garmeh al yisrael.

Amar rabbi yehuda af al gav dezakkaa hava noach lav ihu keday (begin) dekudesha berich hu yagin al alma begineh. ta chaze, moshe la tala milla bizchuteh ella bizchut avahan kadmae. aval noach la hava leh beman deyitle bizchuta kemoshe.

Amar rabbi yitzchak veim kol da kevan deamar leh kudesha berich hu vahakimoti et beriti ittach hava leh lemive rachame alayyhu. vekarbana deakriv levatar, deyakriv leh min kadmat dena dilma yishshachech rugeza mealma.

Amar rabbi yehuda may hava leh lemebad deha chayyayve alma havu margizin kamme kudesha berich hu veihu yakriv karbana. ella vadday noach dachil al garmeh hava, begin dela yeera beh mota bego chayyayve alma dehava chame ovadehon bisha kol yoma, vehech margezan kamme kudesha berich hu kol yoma.

Rabbi (elazar patach) yitzchak amar kol zimna dechayyayve alma asgiu, zakkaa deishtechach benayyhu hu itpas bekadmita. dichtiv, (Yechezkel 9:6) umimmikdashi tachellu. vetaninan al tikre mimmikdashi ella mimmekudashi. venoach hech sheziv leh kudesha berich hu ben kol innun chayyayvaya. ella begin deyifkun minneh toladin bealma dehava tzaddik kedka yeut.

Vetu deihu atre behu kol yoma veyoma vela kabbilu minneh, vekiyyem benafsheh kera dichtiv, (Yechezkel 3:19) veatta ki hizharta rasha vegomer. uchetiv veatta et nafshecha hitztzalta. mikkan kol man deazhar lechayyayva af al gav dela kabbil minneh hu sheziv leh legarmeh vehahu chayyayva itpas bechoveh. vead kamma yazhar leh ad deyimche leh ha ukemuha chavraya.

Rabbi yose hava shechiach kammeh derabbi shimon yoma chad, amar leh may chama kudesha berich hu leshetzaa kol chevat bera veof shemaya immehon dechayayvaya. i bene nasha chatan beire veofe shemaya ushear beriyayn ma chatu. amar leh begin dichtiv ki hishchit kol basar et darko al haaretz. kulhu havu mechabbele archayyhu. shavke zinayhu vedavku bezina ochora.

Ta chaze, innun chayyayve alma garmu hachi lechol biryayn. uvaon (leashkecha) leakkechasha ovada divreshit. veinnun garmu lechol biryayn lechabbela archayyhu kema deinnun mechabbelan. amar kudesha berich hu attun beitu (leashkecha) leakkechasha ovade yeday, ana ashlim reuta dilchon umachiti et kol hayekum asher asiti meal peni haadama. ahadar alma lemayin kema dehava bekadmita mayin bemayin veha ittemar. mikkan ulehala aavid biryayn ochoranin bealma kedka yeut:

Vayyavo noach uvanav veishto uneshe vanav itto. rabbi chiyyay patach veamar (Yirmeyahu 23:24) im yissater ish bammistarim vaani lo erennu neum Adonai. kamma innun bene nasha atimin libba setimin ayynin dela mashgichin vela yadin bikara demarehon dichtiv beh halo et hashshamayim veet haaretz ani male. hech baun beni nasha leistattera mechovayyhu veamre mi roenu umi yodenu. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 29:15) vehaya bemachshach maasehem. lean yittamrun mikkammeh.

Lemalka devana palterin veavad techot ara temirin petzirin. leyomin maradu bene palterin bemalka aschar (atzaer) alayyhu malka begayysoy. ma avadu alu utemiru garmayyhu techot nukeve pesirin. amar malka ana avdit lon umikkammay attun baan leittammara, hada hu dichtiv im yissater ish bammistarim vaani lo erennu neum Adonai. ana hu daavadit nukeve pesirin veavadit chashocha unehora veattun ech yachlin leittammara kammay.

Ta chaze, kad bar nash chate kamme mareh veamshich garmeh leitkasya. kudesha berich hu avid beh dina beitgalya. vechad bar nash adke garmeh kudesha berich hu bae leastara leh dela yitchaze beyom af Adonai. devadday ibbae leh leenash
135: Dela yitchaze kamme mechabbela kad sharya al alma dela yistakkel beh. deha kol innun deyitchazzun kammeh it leh reshu lechabbala.

Vehayeynu dekaamar rabbi shimon kol bar nash deeneh bisha, ena dimchabbela sharya aloy. veihu mechabbela dealma ikre. velibbae leh leinesh leistammera minneh vela leitkerava bahadeh dela yittezak (kammeh). veasir lemikrav bahadeh beitgalya. umishshum hachi meish ra ayin bae leistammera minnih. mikkamme malach hammavet al achat kamma vechamma.

(Veal da) ma ketiv bevilam (Bamidbar 24:3) uneum haggever shetum haayin. deena bisha hava leh uvechol atar dehava mistakkel beh hava amshich aleh ruach mechabbela. uvegin kach hava bae leistakkala behu beyisrael begin dishetze bechol atar deeneh hava mistakkel. ma ketiv vayyissa bilam et enav dezakif ena chad umaich ena chad begin leistakkala behu beyisrael beena bisha.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv vayyar et yisrael shochen lishvatav. vechama dishchinta chafya alayyhu urevia alayyhu mittakkena bitresar shivtin techotah vela yachil leshaltaa alayyhu eneh. amar ech echol lehon deha ruach kaddisha illaa revia alayyhu vechafat lon begadfaha. hada hu dichtiv kara shachav kaari, uchelavi. mi yekimennu. mi yekimennu mealayyhu begin deyitgalyayn veshalta ena alayyhu.

Veal da kudesha berich hu baa lechafya lenoach leistattera meena dela yachil ruach mesoova leshalta aleh begin dela yitchabbel veha ittemar. vayyavo noach kema deittemar leistattera meena. mippene me hammabbul (deha) demayin dachaku leh. amar rabbi yose chama malach hammavet dehava ate (davar acher 33 legabbeh) uvegin kach al letevuta veistammar vah terisar yarche (shatta).

Veammay teresar yarchin. pelige bah rabbi yitzchak verabbi yehuda. chad amar 12 yarchin dechach ihu dina dechayayvaya. vechad amar leashlama tzaddik (nusach acher tzarich) dargin teresar ushear dargin deitchazze leafaka min teva.

Rabbi yehuda amar shitta yarche innun bemaya veshitta yarche beesha. veha hacha mayay havu ammay teresar yarche. amar (leh) rabbi yose bitre dinin degehinnom itdanu bemaya veesha. bemaya demayin denachatu alayyhu milleela havu tzeninin ketalga. beesha demayin denafke mittatta havu retichan keesha. veal da bedina degehinnom itdanu beesha umayay (uvegin kach teresar yarche havo deamar rabbi elazar dina dechayyayvayya begehinnam teresar yarche havo veha ukemuha. veal da kol innun chayyayve alma itdanu bitren dinin illen bemayya vaessa) ad deishtetziu mealma. venoach hava mistatter betevuta veitkasse meena umechabbela la kariv legabbeh, vetevuta ihi hava shatya al anpe maya kema deat amer vayyisu et hatteva vattaram meal haaretz.

Arbaim yom laku. dichtiv vayhi hammabbul arbaim yom al haaretz vegomer. vechol shear zimna itmechun mealma. hada hu dichtiv vayyimmachu min haaretz. vavy lon leinnun chayayvaya deha la yekumun leachyay bealma lemekam bedina hada hu dichtiv vayyimmachu kema deat amer, (Tehillim 9:6) shemam machit leolam vaed. deafillu lemekam bedina la yekumun:

Vayyisu et hatteva vattaram meal haaretz. rabbi abba patach (Tehillim 57:6) ruma al hashshamayim elohim al kol haaretz kevodecha. vavy lon lechayayvaya deinnun chatan umargizin lemarehon bechol yoma. uvechovayyhu dachyayn lah lashshechinta meara. vegarmin detistallek mealma. ushechinta ikre elohim. vealah ketiv ruma al hashshamayim elohim.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv vayyisu et hatteva dedachyayn lah levar. vattaram meal haaretz, dela sharyay bealma veistalkat minnah. vechad istalkat mealma, ha let man deyashgach bealma vedina shalta (bedina) keden aloy. vechad yitmachun chayyayve alma veyistallekun minneh (dealma), shechinta ahadrat medorah bealma.

Amar leh rabbi yesa, i hachi ha ara deyisrael deitmachun chayyayvaya dehavu behahu zimna ammay la ahadderat shechinta leatrah kedivkadmita. amar leh begin dela ishtaaru vah shear zakkae alma. ella (aval) bechol atar deazlu nachtat veshavviat
136: Medorah immehon. uma beara nucheraa ochora la itparsha minnayyhu, kol shekken i ishtearu beara kaddisha.

Veha ittemar. bechol chovin dechayyayve alma dachyayn lah lashshechinta. chad minnayyhu man dimchabbel archeh al ara kidamaran. uvegin kach la chame anpe shechinta vela al befalterin. veal da ketiv beillen vayyimmachu min haaretz itmachun min kolla.

Ta chaze, behahu zimna dezammin kudesha berich hu leachyaya metayay, kol innun metin deyishtakkechun levar bishar arin nucherain kudesha berich hu yivra lon gufayyhu (nusach acher yokim lon begufayyhu) kedka chaze. deha garma chad deishtaar beh bevar nash techot ara hahu garma yitavid kechamira beisa vealeh yivne kudesha berich hu kol gufa.

Vela yahiv lon kudesha berich hu nishmatin ella beara deyisrael. dichtiv, (Yechezkel 37:12) hinne ani poteach et kivrotechem vehaaleti etchem mikkivrotechem ammi veheveti etchem el admat yisrael. deyitgalgelun techot ara. ulevatar ma ketiv venatatti ruchi vachem vichyitem vegomer. deha beara deyisrael yekabbelun nishmatin kol (innun) bene alma. bar illen (dara detofana) deistaavu useivu ara. beillen ketiv vayyimmachu min haaretz. min haaretz dayyka. veaf al gav deakshu veafligu kadmae al da. vayyimmachu kema deat amer, (Tehillim 69:29) yimmachu missefer chayim.

Amar leh rabbi shimon vadday let lon chulaka bealma deate dichtiv vayyimmachu min haaretz. uchetiv leolam yirshu aretz. aval yekumun bedin. vealayyhu ketiv, (Daniel 12:2) verabbim misheni admat afar yakitzu elle lechayye olam veelle lacharafot ulederaon olam. ufelugeta beha aval kolla kema deukemuha chavrayay:

Vayyimmach et kol hayekum asher al pene haadama. rabbi abba amar (et kol) leachlala kol innun shallitin deshaltin memannan al ara. veda hu hayekum asher al pene haadama. dechad avid kudesha berich hu dina bivne alma aavar leinnun shallitin dimmannan alayyhu bekadmita ulevatar leinnun deyatve techot gadfayyhu dichtiv (Yeshayahu 24:21) yifkod Adonai al tzeva hammarom bammarom ulevatar al malche haadama al haadama.

Vehecha mitavran kammeh. ella aavar lon benura dedalik hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:24) ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu el kanna. esha (hu) deachil esha. hahu yakum dealayyhu (nusach acher meever) beesha. veinnun deyatve techotayyhu bemaya. uvegine kach vayyimmach et kol hayekum asher al peni haadama. ulevatar meadam vead behema ad remes vead of hashshamayim vayyimmachu min haaretz. kol illen diltatta. vayyishshaer ach noach. ach limute. dela ishtaaru bealma bar noach udeimmeh betevuta. rabbi yose omer chagir hava deachish leh arya veha ukemuha:

Vayyizkor elohim et noach veet kol hachayya veet kol habbehema asher itto batteva. rabbi chiyyay patach (Mishlei 22:3) arum raa raa venistar. hay kera ittemar al noach deal letevuta veistattar bah. veal lego tevuta bezimna demayyay dachaku leh. veha ittemar dead la al letevuta chama leh lemalach hammavet deazil benayyhu veaschar lon. kevan dechama leh, al latteva veistattar begavvah. hada hu dichtiv arum raa raa venistar. raa raa da malach hammavet venistar mikkammeh hada hu dichtiv mippene me hammabbul.

Rabbi yose amar arum raa raa venistar. (veyaster lo ketiv), ahadar al ma deittemar bezimna demota sharya bealma bar nash chakkim yissater vela yakum levar vela yitchaze kamme mechabbela. begin dechevan deityeyhiv leh reshu, yechabbel kol innun deyishtakkechun kammeh veyaavrun kammeh beitgalyay. vesofa dikra ufetaim avru veneenashu avrin kammeh veitchazyayn kammeh veneenashu. davar acher avru, avru pikkuda (da) (nusach acher demarehon) veneenashu. davar acher arum raa raa venistar da noach. ufetaim avru veneenashu illen bene dareh.
(Veneenashu), kevan deistattar veishtahe tamman kol hahu zimna.
137: Levatar vayyizkor elohim et noach. amar rabbi shimon (vayyizkor elohim et noach) ta chaze beshaata dedina itavid la ketiv beh zechira. kevan deitavid (beh) dina veitavidu chayyayve alma, keden ketiv beh zechira. deha kad dina sharya bealma itchabberuta la ishtechach. umechabbela sharya al alma.
Kevan deitavar dina veishtakkich rugeza, tav kolla leatreh. uvegin kach ketiv hacha vayyizkor elohim et noach. deveh sharya zachor. denoach ish tzaddik ketiv beh.

Ketiv, (Tehillim 89:10) atta moshel begeut hayyam beso gallav atta teshabbechem. beshaata deyamma kafitz begalgule utehome salke venachate, kudesha berich hu shadar chad chuta missitra deyamina umashich galgeloy veshachich zapeh velet man deyada leh.
Yona nachat leyamma veizdamman leh hahu nuna uvala leh. hech la nafkat nishmeteh minneh vela parcha miyyad. ela begin dekudesha berich hu shallit behahu geuta deyamma.

Vehahu geuta deyamma hu chad chuta dismala desalik leh leyamma leela uveh istallak. vei lav hahu chuta demate leh missitra deyamina la salka lealmin. dechad (dechevan) dehahu chuta nachit leyamma veyamma itachid bah keden itarin galgeloy veshaagan lemitraf tarpa. ad dekudesha berich hu ativ leh (lon) leachora vetavin leatrayyhu.

Hada hu dichtiv beso gallav atta teshabbechem. teshabbechem leinnun galle yamma. teshabbechem tetabbar lon leatava leatrayyhu. davar acher teshabbechem mammash shevacha hu lon begin desalkin betiuveta lemechome. mikkan kol man dechasif leistakkala uleminda af al gav dela yachil (nusach acher velo yahavin leh reshuta) shevacha ihu dileh vecholla meshabbechan leh.
Amar rabbi yehuda noach kad hava batteva dachil hava dela yidkar leh kudesha berich hu lealmin. vechevan deitavid dina veitavaru chayyayve alma keden ma ketiv vayyizkor elohim et noach.

Rabbi elazar amarotta chaze, beshaata dedina sharya bealma la libbae leh leenish deyidkar shemeh leela (kammeh dekudesha berich hu bealma). deha i adkar shemeh yidkerun chovoy (kullehu) veyetun leashgacha beh.

Menalan mishshunammit, dehahu yoma yom tov derosh hashshana hava vekudesha berich hu dain alma. ucheden amar leh elisha (Melachim 2 4:13) hayesh ledabber lach el hammelech da kudesha berich hu. dichden ikre melech. melech hakkadosh melech hammishpat. vattomer betoch ammi anochi yoshavet. la baena deyidkerun li veyishgechun bi ella betoch ami. man deayyil resheh ben amma (kolla) la yishgechun aleh lemedan leh levish. begine chach amra betoch ammi.

Ta chaze, noach beshaata derugeza sharya bealma la idkar. kevan dedina itavar ma ketiv vayyizkor elohim et noach hasheta idkar shemeh. davar acher vayyizkor elohim et noach kema deat amer vaezkor et beriti.

Rabbi chizkiyya hava azil mikkappotkiyya lelud. paga beh rabbi yesa. amar leh tevavhna alach deat bilchodach. deha taninan dela yippuk bar nash yechiday bearcha. amar leh ravya chad azil bahaday veihu ate avatray. amar leh veal da tevavhna ech azil bahadach man dela tishtae beh mille deorayyta. deha taninan kol man deazil bearcha velav immeh mille deorayyta istakkan benafsheh. amar leh hachi hu vadday.
Adhachi mata hahu ravya. amar leh rabbi yesa beri mean atar ant. amar leh mikkarta delud veshamana dehay bar nash chakkim azil tamman vezammina garmay lefulechanih ulemehach bahadeh.
Amar leh beri yedat mille deorayyta. amar leh yedana deha abba hava olif li befarashat karbanot vearchina udenay lemay dehava amar im achi deihu keshisha minnay. amar leh rabbi yesa beri ema li.

Patach veamar vayyiven noach mizbeach laAdonai vayyikkach mikkol habbehema hattehora umikkol haof hattahor vayyaal olot bammizbeach. vayyiven noach mizbeach, da ihu mizbeach deakriv beh adam kadmaa. noach
138: Ammay kariv ola. deha ola la salka ella begin hirhura delibba (diruta) venoach bemma chav. ella noach hirher veamar ha kudesha berich hu gazar dina al alma deyitcharav, dilma begin desheziv li kol zechuta paka li vela yishtaar li zechu bealma. miyyad vayyiven noach mizbeach laAdonai.
Hahu mizbeach deakriv beh adam harishon hava. i hachi ammay vayyiven. ella begin dechayyayve alma garmu dela kayyma beducheteh. kevan deata noach ketiv beh vayyiven.

Vayyaal olot olat ketiv chada (hu). ketiv, (Vayikra 1:13) ola hiv ishshe reach nichoach laAdonai (leolam ola salleka dechar. i) ola salka dechar vela salka nukeva dichtiv zachar tamim yakrivennu. ammay ketiv ishshe deha esh bae leishtakkecha tamman.

Ela af al gav deola itkeriv dachar. uleatreh itkeriv. nukeva la baya leitparsha minneh, ella bah itkeriv begin lechabbera da beda. desalka nukeva legabbe dechura leitchabbera kechada. veaf al gav deishshe leshum ishim.

Noach itzterich leh lemikrav ola. deihu beatar didchura. avad leh kudesha berich hu leitchabbera uleaalaa batteva. veal da akriv ola. ola hu ishshe. esh Adonai deitchabbar (bah) semala benukeva. deha (kol) nukeva missitra dismala ka atya udechura misitra dimina beitdabbekuta da beda. uvegin kach ikre nukeva ishshe. ishshe ketiru dirchimu deachid bah semala lesalka lah leela uleitkashshera kechada. uvegin kach (davar acher ketiv) ola hiv ishshe. keshiru didchar venukeva da beda:

Vayyarach Adonai et reach hannichoach. uchetiv ishshe reach nichoach. ishshe hachi shemana tenana veesha mechubbarin kechada. deha let tenana bela esha kema dichtiv (Shemot 19:18) vehar sinay ashan kullo mippene asher yarad alav Adonai baesh.

Ta chaze (nasha 137, 138) esh nafik millegav veihu dak. veachid bemilla ochora levar delav ihu dak hachi veitachadan da beda ucheden tenana salka. may tama begin deitachid esha bemilla deragish. vesimanaych chutema denafik beh tenana miggo esha.

Veal da ketiv (Devarim 33:10) yasimu ketora beappecha. begin deahadar esha leatreh. vechotma (itregish) itkenish behahu recha lego lego ad deitachid kolla vetav leatreh. veitkeriv kolla lego machshava veitavid reuta chada. ucheden reach nichoach. denach rugeza veitavid nayycha.

Deha tenana itkenish veayyil vekamit beesha veesha achid bitnana veayyle tarvavyyhu lego lego ad denach rugeza. vechad itachid (achid) kola da veda venach rugeza, keden hu nayycha, ukeshiru chad veitkere nayycha. nayycha derucha chedvavta decholla kechada. nehiru devotzinin nehiru deanpin. uvegin kach ketiv, vayyarach Adonai et reach hannichoach. keman dearach vechanish kolla lego atreh.

Ata rabbi yesa uneshakeh. amar uma kol haden tava it techot yedach vela yedana beh. amar ahadarna min orcha, venitchabber bahadach. azlu. amar rabbi chizkiyya archa da bahade shechinta nehach deha mitakna kamman. achid bida dehahu yenuka veazlu. amru leh ema lan kera chad meinun deamar lach avuch.

Patach hahu yenuka veamar (Shir HaShirim 1:2) yishshakeni minshikot pihu, da hu teovta illaa deyippuk (denafka) reuta mippuma lenashka vela nafik mechotma kad esha nafka, deha kad itchabber puma lenashka nafik esha biruta binhiru deanpin bechedva dechola beitdabbekuta denayycha.

Uvegin kach ki tovim dodecha miyyayin. mehahu yayin (yayin) demechode venahir anpin vechayychin ayynin veavid reuta. velav miyyayin dimshakker (desachir) veavid rugeza veachshich anpin velahatan ayynin yayin derugeza.
Veal da begin dechamar da tav, nahir anpin vechade ayynin veavid tiuveta dirchimu, makrivin leh kol yoma al gabbe madbecha
139: Shiura deman deshate leh chade leh veavid leh nayycha dichtiv (Bamidbar 28:5) venisko yayin reviit hahin. uvegin kach ki tovim dodecha miyyayin. mehahu yayin deitar rechimuta vetiuveta.

Vecholla kema diltatta itar rechimuta dilela. teren sheraggin kad itdaach nehora dilela bitnana desalik mehahu diltatta itdelik hahu dilela. amar rabbi chizkiya hachi hu vadday dealma illaa talya betattaa vetattaa beillaa, umezimna deitcheriv be makdesha birchan la ishtakkachu leela vetatta. leachazaa deda beda talya.

Veamar rabbi yose birchan la ishtakkachu ulevavtin ishtakkachu, deha yeniku decholla behahu sitra nafke (davar acher uvirkan lo nafke), may tama, begin deyisrael la sharyayn beara vela palche pulechana deitzterich leadlaka botzinin uleishtakkacha birchan, uvegin kach la mishtakkeche leela vetatta, vealma la yativ bekiyyumeh kedka yeut.

Veamar rabbi chizkiyya lo osif lekallel od et haadama baavur haadam. may hu, amar rabbi yesa hachi shemana merabbi shimon deamar kol zimna deesha dilela osif letakfa, tenana deihu dina diltatta atkif rugeza veshatze kolla. begin dechad nafik esha let leh pesek (kammeh) ad deyishtelim dina. vechad dina diltatta la osif leittakfa bedina dilela avid dina ufasik vela yishtallam dina leshetzaa. uvegin kach ketiv lo osif lemehav tosefet leittakfa dina diltatta.

Amar hahu yenuka shemana begin dichtiv arura haadama baavurecha. deha behahi shaata deitlatya ara bechova deadam. ityeyhiv reshu leshaltaa alah hahu chivya visha deihu mechabbela dealma veshatze bene alma. mehahu yoma dekariv noach karbana, vearach leh kudesha berich hu, ityeyhiv reshu leara lenafka mittechot hahu nachash venafka mimsaava. veal da makrivin yisrael karbana lekudesha berich hu begin leanhara appe ara. amar rabbi chizkiyya yaot hu (vehi) vehay hava tale ad dekayymu yisrael al tura desinay. amar rabbi yiyisa kudesha berich hu azir lah lesihara veshalta hahu nachash, aval begin chova deadam itlatyay begin lemelat alma. behahu yoma (daatayyhebat orayyta) nafkat ara mehahi kelala vekayyma sihara behahi geriuta, bar beshaata dekurebana ishtakkachu bealma veyisrael yatvin al arahon.
Amar rabbi yesa lehahu yenuka ma shemach, amar leh abba. amar leh abba tehe becholla bechachma uveshanin. kara aleh (Mishlei 23:25) yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha.

Amar rabbi chizkiyya zammin kudesha berich hu leaavara ruach mesoova min alma kema (davar acher 33 deittemar) dichtiv, (Zecharya 13:2) veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavet lanetzach umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kol panim vecherpat ammo yasir meal kol haaretz ki Adonai dibber.

Vezammin kudesha berich hu leanhara lesihara velafaka lah mechashocha begin hahu chivya visha. kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 30:26) vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim keor shivat hayyamim. may or, hahu or deganiz leh kudesha berich hu beovada divreshit:

Vayvarecha elohim et noach veet banav vayyomer lahem peru urevu vegomer. rabbi abba patach veamar, (Mishlei 10:22) birkat Adonai hi taashir velo yosif etzev immah. birkat Adonai da shechinta deihi itpakda al birchan dealma, uminnah nafke birchan lecholla.

Ta chaze ma ketiv bekadmita vayyomer Adonai lenoach bo atta vechol betcha el hatteva vegomer. kema deittemar demareh deveta yahav leh reshu lemeal. levatar itteta amra leh lenafka. bekadmita al birshuta devaalah, lesof nafak birshu deitteta. mikkan olifna mareh
140: Deveta yail veitteta tafik, hada hu dichtiv vayyomer elohim el noach lemor tze min hatteva. dershu hava vidaha leafaka leh leushepiza vela leaala leh.

Kevan denafak yahav mattenan lah, begin deihi beveta uveta bidaha. veinun mattenan deyahav lah begin leasgaa lah rechimuta bevaalah. mikkan olifna orach ara leushepiza. (lemehav bida devalah kad nafak yahev mattenan leitteteh velo beyadah uvegin kach kevan dihav leh mattenan) veal da levatar deyahav lah mattenan leasgaa lah rechimuta bevaalah (nusach acher kevan denafak yahev mattenan unevizbezan bida devalah lemehav leitteteh ulemechode bah uleasgaa la rechimuta bevalah, hada hu dichtiv vayyikkach mikkol vegomer vayyaal olot bammizbeach, illen mattenan dihav bida devalah begin leasgaa la rechimuta bealma, umikkan olifna orach ara leushepiza dihav mattenan bida devalah leitteteh velo bidaha, veal da vayyaal olot bammizbeach, kurebana lidchura leasgaa rechimuta bevalah varacha leh) barcha leh, dichtiv vayvarech elohim et noach veet banav vayyomer lahem peru urevu vegomer. uvegin kach ketiv, (Mishlei 10:22) birkat Adonai hi taashir. vadday kema deittemar.

Velo yosif etzev immah. raza dichtiv beitztzavon tochalenna. itztzavon atzivu verugeza bela nehiru deanpin. kad itchashach sihara uvirchan la mishtakkeche. beitztzavon sitra derucha ochora deimna birchan mealma, uvegin kach velo yosif etzev immah. veda hu raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 8:21) lo osif lekallel od et haadama:

Umoraachem vechittechem yihye. mikkan ulehala yehe lechon deyyoknin divne nasha deha bekadmita la havu diukenin divne nasha. ta chaze, bekadmita ketiv, (Bereshit 9:6) betzelem elohim asa et haadam. uchetiv, (Bereshit Adonai:1) bidmut elohim asa oto. kevan dechatu ishtannu deyukenayyhu mehahu diukena illaa veithappachu inun lemidchal mikkamme chevavn bera.

Bekadmita kol beriyyayn dealma zakfan ayynin vechaman diukena kaddisha illaa vezaan vedachalin mikkammeh. kevan dechatu ithappach deyukenayyhu meenayyhu lidyukena ochora. veithappach divne nasha zain vedachalin kamme shear beriyyayn.

Ta chaze, kol inun bene nasha dela chatan kamme marehon vela avrin al pikkude orayyta. ziv diukena dilhon la ishtanne mechezu didyukena illaa. vechol beriyyayn dealma zain vedachalin kammeh. uveshaata divni nasha avrin al pitgame orayyta, itchallaf diukena dilhon vechulhu zain vedachalin mikkamme beriyayn ochoranin, begin deitchallaf diukena illaa veitavar minnayyhu, ucheden shalte behu chevat bera, deha la chamu behu hahu diukena ilaa kidkachaze.

Veal kach hasheta kevan dealma itchaddash kemillekaddemin, barich lon beracha da veshallit lon al kolla, kema deat amer vechol dege hayyam beyedchem nittanu. veafillu nune yamma. rabbi chiyyay amar beyedchem nittanu. mikkadmat dena. dechad bera kudesha berich hu alma mesar kolla bidehon dichtiv uredu vidgat hayyam uveof hashshamayim vegomer.

Vayvarecha elohim et noach. rabbi chizkiyya patach (tehillim lak) ledavid maskil ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa. hay kera ukemuha, aval kera da beraza dechachmeta ittemar. deha taninan baasara zine shevacha shabbach david lekudesha berich hu vechad minnayyhu maskil. vehu darga chad meinun asara. vedavid atkin garmeh ad la yishre aloy hay darga.

Ashre nesuy pesha, deha beshaata dekudesha berich hu atkil chove vezachvavn divne nasha dehahu (davar acher kad hahu) tikla devistar chovin mistallekin veinun ochoranin zachyayn deinun betikla ochora machriin letatta da hu nesuy pesha.
