Kesuy chataa beshaata dedina sharya bealma dihe mechafya dela yishlot aloy mechabbela, kema dehava lenoach dechasse leh kudesha berich hu mehahu chataa deamshich aleh adam al alma. dechevan dechataa da angid adam al alma, shear beriyyayn shaltan uvar nash dachil minnayyhu vealma la atkin betikkunih. uvegin kach kad nafak noach mittevuta kudesha berich hu barcheh. dichtiv vayvarech elohim et noach veet banav vegomer:
Veattem peru urevu. behanne birchan la ishtakkachu nukeve, ella et noach veet banav, aval nukeve la amar kera. amar rabbi shimon veattem kelala didchure
141: Venukeve kechada. vetu et noach leasgaa nukeveh. veet banav leasgaa nukeve dilhon.

Uvegin kach ketiv attem peru urevu lemebad toldot mikkan ulehala shirtzu vaaretz. vehacha yahiv lon kudesha berich hu sheva pikkude orayyta lon ulechol deatu abbatrayyhu, ad dekayymu yisrael betura desinay veityeyhav lon kol pikkude orayyta kechada:

Vayyomer elohim lenoach vegomer. zot ot habberit asher ani noten beni uvenechem vegomer. et kashti natatti beanan. natatti mikkadmat dena. rabbi shimon patach (Yechezkel 1:26) umimmaal larakia asher al rosham kemare even sappir demut kisse. ma ketiv leela vaeshma et kol kanfehem kekol mayim rabbim kekol shadday belechtan. illen arba chevavn ravrevan illain kaddishin dehahu rakia mittakkena alayyhu. vechulhu gadfayyhu (davar acher 33 perishan) mitchabberan da beda lechafyay gufayyhu.

Uveshaata deinun parse gadfayyhu, ishtema kol gadfin dechulhu deamre shirata, hada hu dichtiv kekol shadday. dela ishtechich lealmin. kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 30:13) lemaan yezammercha chavod velo yiddom. umay amre, (Tehillim 98:2) hodia Adonai yeshuato leene haggoym gilla tzidkato.

Kol hamulla kekol machan, kekol mashshiryayta kaddisha kad mitchabberan kol chelin illain leela. umay amre kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai tzevaot melo chol haaretz kevodo. ahadderu ledarom amru kadosh, ahadderu letzafon amru kadosh. ahadderu lemizrach amru kadosh. ahadderu lemaarav amru baruch.
Vehay rakia kaim al reshehon. uvechol atar deihi azla, ascharu appin lehahi sitra deitkelilu anpin beh. ischaru anpin learba zavyayn, vechulhu mistacharin letatta.

Beribbua dileh itgelifat bearba anpin, anpe arye. anpe nishra. anpe shor. anpe adam. galif bechulhu adam. anpe arye adam. anpe nesher adam. anpe shor (davar acher adam). kulhu kelilan beh. uvegin kach ketiv udemut penehem pene adam.

Vehay rakia deitrabba kulhu gevavnin kelilan beh, arba gevavnin itchazzeyayn beh gelifin bearba arba. bearba gelifin reshimin tehirin illain vetattain. kad mitparshan gevavnin deinun arba salkin teresar. gavavn yarok. gavavn sumak. gavvavn chivvavr. gavavn sappir deitkelilu mikkol gevavnin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:28) kemare hakkeshet asher yihye beanan beyom haggeshem ken mare hannoga saviv hu mare demut kevod Adonai. chezu digvavnin decholla. uvegin kach et kashti natatti beanan.

May kashti, kema deittemar beyosef dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:24) vatteshev beetan kashto. begin deyosef tzaddik ikre, uvegin kach kashto da berit dekeshet deitkelil betzaddik, divrit da beda itachid. uvegin denoach hava tzadik, kayyma dileh keshet.

Vayyafozu. may vayyafozu, anhiru bachamidu decholla. kema deat amer (Tehillim 19:11) hannechemadim mizzahav umippaz rav umetukim. itnehiru binhiru illaa kad natar berit. uvegin kach ikre yosef hatztzaddik. al da ikre hakkeshet berit, kalil da beda.

Zahara yekara illaa chezu dechol chezu chazu kechezu temirin (nusach acher temira) gevavnin temirin. gevavnin dela itgalyayn. velet reshu leistakkala beena bakkeshet kad itchaze bealma dela yitchaze kelana bishchinta. vechen gevavnin dekeshet hu chezu sostifa ketira kechezu yekara illaa dela leistakkala.

Vechevan deara chamat lehay keshet keyayma kaddisha, itkayymat bekiyyuma. veal da vehayta leot berit ben elohim vegomer. hay deamaran deillen telat gevavnin vechad deitkelil benayyhu kulhu raza chada. uvego anana salka leitchazaa.

(Yechezkel 1:26) umimmaal larakia asher al rosham kemare even sappir. hay hi even shetiyya deihi nekuda chada dechol alma. vekayyma alah kodesh hakkodashim. umay hi, kurseyay kaddisha illaa deihi memanna al illen arba demut kisse bearba samchin, veda hu tora shebbeal pe.
Veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam alav millemala. da hu tora shebbichtav. mikkan detora shebbichtav yeshauun
142: Yatah al tora shebbeal pe. begin dehay kurseyay leda, kemare adam deihu diukena deyaakov deihu yativ alah.

Rabbi yehuda kam lelya chad lemile beorayyta befalgu lelya beve ushepiza bemata machseya. vehava tamman beveta chad yuday deata bitre kesira dekatfira. patach rabbi yehuda veamar (Bereshit 28:22) vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva yihye bet elohim. da hi even shetiyya demittamman ishtil alma veala itbene be makdesha.

Zakaf resheh hahu yuday veamar lah hay milla ech efshar, veha even shetiyya ad la itbere alma havat uminah ishtil alma, veat amart vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva. demashma deyaakov shave lah hasheta dichtiv, (Bereshit 28:22) vayyikkach et haeven asher sam meraashotav. vetu deyaakov bevet el hava vehay avna havat biyrushala 40.

Rabbi yehuda la aschar resheh legabbeh, patach veamar (Amos 4:12) hikkon likrat elokecha yisrael. uchetiv, (Devarim 27:9) haseket ushema yisrael. mille deorayyta bayayn kavvavna. umillin deorayyta baan leittakkana begufa ureuta kechada. kam hahu yuday veitlabbash, veyativ legabbeh derabbi yehuda, veamar zakkain attun tzaddikaya demishtaddele beorayyta yoma velele.

Amar leh rabbi yehuda hasheta dechavvnat garmach, ema milach denitchabber kechada. deha mille deorayyta bayayn tikkuna degufa vetikkuna delibba. vei lav bearsay shechivna uvelibbay amarna millin. ella ha taninan deafillu chad deyativ velae beorayyta shechinta itchabberat bahadeh, uma shechinta hacha veana shachiv bearsay. vela od ella devaayayn tzachuta.

Vetu dechol bar nash (achare mot 67 1) dekam lemile beorayyta mippalgu lelya kad itar ruach tzafon (befalgu delelya) kudesha berich hu ate leishtashea im tzaddikaya beginta deeden. vehu vechol tzaddikayay divginta kulhu tzayytin (leh vatzeyytayn) leillen millin denafke mippumeh. uma kudesha berich hu vechol tzaddikayyay mitaddenin lemishma mille deorayyta beshaata da veana ehe shachiv bearsay. amar leh hasheta ema milach.

Amar leh sheelna al ma deamart bifsuka da (raza deeven shetiyya deamrat) vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva yihye bet elohim deda even shetiya. (hasheta detzayit lemilay) hech efshar, deha even shetiyya ad la itbere alma havat uminnah ishtil alma, veat amart asher samti, demashma deyaakov shavve lah hasheta. uchetiv vayyikkach et haeven asher sam meraashotav.

Vetu deyaakov bevet el hava veavna da havat biyrushalam. amar leh kol ara deyisrael ichpal techotoy vehahu even techoteh havat. amar leh asher sam ketiv. uchetiv vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva. amar leh i yadat milla ema lah.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 17:15) ani vetzedek echoze fanecha esbea vehakitz temunatecha. david malka chavivuta udevekuta dileh behay even hava. vealah amar (Tehillim 118:22) even maasu habbonim hayta lerosh pinna. vechad baa leistakkela bechizu yekara demareh, netal lehay even bideh bekadmita ulevatar ayil.

Begin dechol man devae leitchazaa kamme mareh, la ail ella behay even. dichtiv, (Vayikra 13) bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh. vedavid meshabbach garmeh veamar ani betzedek echoze fanecha. vechol ishtaddeluteh dedavid leitchazaa behay even kedka yeut legabbe dilela.

Ta chaze, avraham atkin tzelota detzafra veoda tivu demareh bealma. veatkin hahi shaata betikkunaha kedka yaot dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:3) vayyashkem avraham babboker. yitzchak atkin tzelota demincha veoda bealma deit din veit dayyayn deyachol leshezava ulemedan alma.
Yaakov atkin tzelota dearvit, uvegin tzelota da deatkin ma dela atkin var nash mikkadmat dena kedka yeut. vegin kach shabbach garmeh veamar
143: Vehaeven hazzot asher samti matztzeva. dead hahi shaata la shavvi lah ochora kavvavteh.

Uvegin kach vayyikkach et haeven asher sam meraashotav vayyasem otah matztzeva. may matztzeva dehava nefila veokim lah. vayyitztzok shemen al roshah. deha beyaakov talya milta lemebad yattir mikkol bene alma.

Ata rabbi yehuda uneshakeh, amar leh vechol hay yedat (vehech) veat mishtaddel bischorata umannach chayye alma. amar leh dehava dechika li shaata, veit li teren benin vekayymin kol yoma beve rav veana ishtaddalna al mezonayyhu ulemehav lon agar lemorayyhu begin deyishtaddelun beorayyta.

Patach veamar, (Melachim 1 2:12) ushelomo yashav al kisse david aviv vattikkon malchuto meod. may shevacha da. ella deatkin even shetiyya veshavve alah kodesh hakkodashim ucheden vattikkon malchuto meod.
Uchetiv, (Bereshit 9:16) ureitiha lizkor berit olam. deha kudesha berich hu tiuveta dileh bah tadir, uman dela itchaze bah la ail kamme mareh. veal da ketiv ureitiha lizkor berit olam.
Ureitiha. may ureitiha, raza hu kema deat amer (Yechezkel 9:4) vehitveta tav al mitzchot vegomer. leitchazzaa alayyhu. veikka deamre da reshimu deat kaddisha di bevisra.

Amar rabbi yehuda vadday kolla hu. (davar acher hachi) aval hay keshet deitchaze bealma beraza ilaa kayyma. vechad yifkun yisrael min galuta zemina hay keshet leitkashta begavvnoy kechalla da demitkashsheta levaalah.

Amar leh hahu yuday kach amar li abba kad hava mistallak mealma (amar li) la tetzappe leragle dimshicha ad deyitchaze hay keshet bealma (davar acher 33 baanana) mitkashta begavvni nehirin veyitnehir lealma. ucheden tzefe leh lemashiach.

Menalan, dichtiv ureitiha lizkor berit olam. vehasheta deitchazzeya bigvavnin chashochin mitchazzeya leducherana (vehi lizkor) dela yiyite mabbul. aval behahi zimna itchazzeyay bigvavnin nehirin umitkashsheta betikkuna kechalla demitkashsheta levaalah ucheden lizkor berit olam veyidkar kudesha berich hu lehay berit deihu begaluta veyakim lah meafra hada hu dichtiv, (Hoshea 3:Adonai) uvikkeshu et Adonai elohehem veet david malkam. uchetiv, (Yirmeyahu 30:9) veavdu et Adonai elohehem veet david malkam asher akim lahem, asher akim meafar kema deat amer, (Amos 9:11) akim et sukkat david hannofalet. veal da ureitiha lizkor berit olam uleakma lah meafra.

Veamar hachi abba divgin kach idkar beorayyta purekana deyisrael udechurana dilah. veda hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 54:9) asher nishbati meavor me noach od al haaretz ken nishbati miktzof alayich umiggear bach:
Vayyihyu beni noach hayyotzim min hatteva. rabbi elazar amar kevan dichtiv vayyihyu bene noach. ammay amar hayyotzim min hatteva. vechi benin ochoranin havu leh dela nafke min tevuta.
Amar leh rabbi abba in. deha levatar olidu benoy benin. dichtiv veelle toldot shem vegomer. veinun la nafke miggo tevuta. uvegin kach ketiv hayyotzim min hatteva shem cham vayafet.

Rabbi shimon amar illu havena shechiach bealma kad yahiv kudesha berich hu sifra dechanoch bealma vesifra deadam, atkifna dela yishtakkechun bene enasha, begin dela chayyshu kol chachaman leistakkela behu vetaan bemillin ochoranin leafaka mershu illaa lirshu ochora. vehasheta ha chakkime alma yadin millin vesatmin lon umittakfe befulechana demarehon.

Vehay kera ashkachna beraza derazin. (tosefta) dechad itar chedva dechol chedvavn temira setima savta desavtin anhir minneh nehiru dakkik. chedva dechol chedvavn nahir leyamina bimshach revut illaa. venahir lismala bechedvav dechamra tav, nahir leemtzaita bechedvav (davar acher deargevavna) ditren sitrin. ruach itar veruach salka veityeyhiv berucha.
Davkan da beda. telat alin bitlat. miggo telat nafka chad berit dedavka bivrit. itavarat ruach desalka, mitavarat minneh. kad ityeyhivat bitren sitrin itdabbeku rucha berucha
144: Umitabberan mittelat benin. venoach veteva nafku minnayyhu telata, kegavvna ditlata (diltatta) illain, veillen inun denafku miggo tevuta shem vecham veyafet. shem devistar yamina, cham devistar semala. yefet argevavna dechalil lon.

Vecham hu avi chenaan. zuhama dedahava techot kastifin. itaruta derucha mesaava denachash kadmaa. uvegin kach reshim veamar, vecham hu avi chenaan. deayyte levavtin al alma. hahu chenaan deitlatteya. hahu chenaan deachshich anpe beriyyayn.

Uvegin kach (kullehu) la nafik miggo kelala dechulhu ella da dichtiv vecham hu avi chenaan. hahu deachshich alma, vela ketiv bichlala da veshem hu avi chach o yefet hu avi chach, ella miyyad kafatz veamar vecham hu avi chenaan. vadday.

Veal da kad ata avraham ma ketiv (Bereshit 12:6) vayyaavor avram baaretz. dead la hava kiyyuma deavahan vela atu zara deyisrael bealma, deyippuk shema da veyeul shema illaa kaddisha. kad havu zakkain yisrael ikre ara al shema da eretz yisrael. kad la zachu ikre ara al shema ochora, eretz kenaan.

Veal da ketiv, (Bereshit 9:25) vayyomer arur kenaan eved avadim yihye leechav. deihu ayyte levavtin al alma. uvenachash ma ketiv, (Bereshit 3:14) arur atta mikkol habbehema. hayeynu dichtiv eved avadim. veal da ketiv shem cham veyafet. telat ilen bene noach hayyotzim min hatteva kidkaamrinan:

Shelosha elle beni noach. kiyyuma dechol alma, kiyyuma deraza illaa. umeelle naftza chol haaretz. hayeynu raza (da) ditlat gevavnin illain. dechad hahu nahar denagid venafik ashke leginta bechela ditlat illen illain. umittamman itparshan gevavnin diltatta kol chad vechad kalil bechavreh, leachazaa dikara dekudesha berich hu itpashshat leela vetatta, veihu chad beillae vetattae.

Amar rabbi elazar telat gevavnin illen bechol inun deatyayn missetar dikdusha, umechezu ditlat gevavnin illen mitparshan lechol inun deatyayn missitra derucha ochora. vechad tistakkel beraza dedargin tishkach hech mitparshan gevavnin lechol inun sitrin ad deayylin letatta beraza deinun shiva veesrin tzinnorin (sitre) dedashshe dechafyayn lithome.

Vecholla yedia lachachimin elyonin. zakkaa chulakhon detzaddikayay dekudesha berich hu itrae bikrehon vegale lon sitrin illain dechachmeta, alayyhu ketiv, (Tehillim 25:14) sod Adonai lireav uverito lehodiam.

Patach rabbi elazar veamar (Yeshayahu 25:1) Adonai elohay atta aromimcha ode shimcha ki asita pele etzot merachok emuna omen. kamma it lon livne nasha leistakkala bikra dekudesha berich hu uleshabbecha likareh. begin dechol man deyada leshabbecha lemareh kedka yaot, kudesha berich hu avid leh reuteh. vela od ella deasge birchan leela vetatta.

Veal da man deyada leshabbecha leh lemareh uleyachada shemeh, chaviv hu leela vechamid letatta vekudesha berich hu mishtabbeach beh (nusach acher bikareh), vealeh ketiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yishrael asher becha etpaer:

Vayyachel noach ish haadama vayyitta kerem. rabbi yehuda verabbi yose. chad amar miggan eden (aterakebat) ittarchat unetziv lah hacha. vechad amar beara havat veakar lah veshatal lah, uvehahu yoma avdat ibbin venitzat lavlevin veanavim vehava sachit lah veshate min chamra verave.

Rabbi shimon amar raza dechachmeta ihu hacha behay kera. kad baa noach lemivdak behahu chova devadak adam harishon. lav leitdabbeka beh, ella leminda uleatkana alma vela yachil. sachat anavim lemivdak behahu kerem. kevan demata lehay, (davar acher keden) vayyishkar vayyitgal. vela hava leh chela lemekam. uvegin kach vayyitgal galle pirtza dealma dehava satim. betoch oholo ketiv beHei. veal da ketiv veal tikrav el petach betah. betoch
145: Kegavvna da bene aharon detaninan shetuye yayin havu. vechi man yahiv lon chamra behahu atar lemishte. i salka datach deinun chatzifin havu deravo chamra. lav hachi, ella vadday mehahu chamra ravo dichtiv, (Vayikra 10:1) vayyakrivu lifne Adonai esh zara. ketiv hacha esh zara uchetiv hatam (Mishlei 7:Adonai) lishmarcha meishsha zara vecholla chad milla.

Vechen kegavvna da vayyesht min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal. veal da itar cham avi chenaan kema deittemar veityehiv atar lichnaan leshaltaa, umay dehava haden tzaddik beraza divrit serso. vetanya deaavar mineh hahu kiyyuma.

Uvegin kach amar arur deha levavtin itaru bekadmita al yedeh bealma. (veal da vayyomer arur kenaan deha levavtin yetun al alma kekadmita). eved avadim yihye kema deat amer arur atta mikkol habbehema vegomer. kolla yittakkan lezimna deate vehu la yittakkan. vecholla yifkun lecheru vehu la yippuk. veraza ihu leinun deyade archoy ushevile deorayyta.

Patach veamar (Tehillim 51:5) ki feshaay ani eda vechattati negdi tamid. kamma it lon livne nasha leistammera mechovayyhu mikkame kudesha berich hu. deha levatar dechata bar nash rashim hu choveh leela vela itmechak bar betukefa dityuveta sagya. kema deat amer, (Yirmeyahu 2:22) ki im techabbesi banneter vetarbi lach borit nichtam avonech lefanay.

Ta chaze, kevan dechav var nash kamme kudesha berich hu zimna chada avid reshimu. vechad chav beh zimna tinyayna ittakkaf hahu reshimu yattir. chav beh zimna telitaa itpashshat hahu kitma missitra da lesitra da, keden ketiv nichtam avonech lefanay.

Ta chaze, david malka kevan dechav kamme kudesha berich hu al iska devat sheva, chashiv dehahu chova itreshim aleh lealmin. ma ketiv, (Shmuel 2 12:13) gam Adonai heevir chattatcha lo tamut. (kudesha berich hu) aavar hahu reshimu mikkammeh.
Amar leh rabbi abba veha taninan devat sheva dileh dedavid malka havat min yoma deitbere alma, ammay yahavah kudesha berich hu leuriya hachitti min kadmat dena.

Amar leh hachi orchoy dekudesha berich hu af al gav deitteta azmina leh levar nash lemeheve dileh, akdim achara unesiv lah ad demata zimneh dehay. kevan demata zimneh, itdachyay hay denasiv lah mikkamme hay ochora deate levatar veistallak mealma. vekashe kammeh kudesha berich hu leaavara leh mealma ad la mate zimneh mikkamme hay ochora.

Veraza devat sheva deityeyhivat leuriya hachitti (kedaamaran) bekadmita, puk veduk vetishkach. ammay ityehivat ara kaddisha lichnaan ad la yetun yisrael. vetishkach milla da. vecholla raza chada ihu umilla chada.

Ta chaze, david af al gav deode al choveh vetav bityuveta, la aade libbeh ureuteh meinun chovin dechav, umehahu chova devat sheva, begin dedachil alayyhu tadir dilma garim chad minnayyhu vikatreg aleh beshaata desakkana. uvegin kach la anshe lon mineh umeruteh.

Davar achar ki feshaay ani eda kulhu dargin detalyayn behu chove bene nasha ani eda. vechattati negdi tamid da pegimu desihara dela nafka misuveta ad deata shelomo veitnehirat beashlamuta. ucheden itbassam alma vitivu yisrael lerachatzan dichtiv, (Melachim 1 Adonai:Adonai) vayyeshev yehuda veyisrael lavetach ish tachat gafno vetachat teenato. veim kol da vechattati negdi tamid. vela itpesak mealma. ad deyete malka meshicha lezimna deate kema deittemar (Zecharya 13:2) veet ruach hattumea aavir min haaretz:

Hu haya gibbor tzayyid lifni Adonai al ken yeamar kenimrod gibbor tzayid lifne Adonai. ta chaze, hu hava gevar takkif. levushoy deadam harishon hava lavish vehava yada lemetzad tzeda divriyyayta behu.

Amar rabbi elazar nimrod hava mefatte livriyyayta lemehach batar pulechan deavoda zara vehava shallit beinun levushin venatzach bene alma vehava amar deihu shallita bealma ufalchin leh beni nasha. veammay ikre shemeh nimrod demarad bemalka illaa dilela demarad beillae umarad betattae.
146: Levushin shallit al kol (davar acher shear) beni alma umalach behu umarad bemareh veamar deihu shallita dealma vehava mefatte livriyyayta avatreh ad demashach bene nasha lemefak mibbatar pulechana demare alma. amar rabbi shimon beilen levushin yade behu chavrayay raza illaa:

Matnitin. vayhi chol haaretz safa achat udevarim achadim. rabbi shimon patach (Melachim 1 6:7) vehabbayit behibbanoto even shelema massa nivna umakkavot vehaggarzen kol kele barzel lo nishma babbayit behibbanoto. (hay kera it leistakkela beh), vehabbayit behibbanoto. vechi la hava bani leh shelomo vechulhu umanin dehavu tamman, mahu behibbanoto.

Ella kach hu kema dichtiv, (Shemot 25:31) miksha tease hamenora. im hi miksha mahu tease. ella vadday kolla beat venissa itavid ihu miggarmeh. kevan desharan lemebad avidta olif leumanin lemebad bah ma delo havu yadin mikkadmat dena.

May tama begin devircheta dekudesha berich hu shera al yedayyhu, veal da ketiv behibbanoto ihu itbeni miggarmeh, dehu ulefa ulefan leumanin hech sharan lemebad, vela istallak meenayyhu reshimu dehahu avidta mammash umistakkelan beh veavde ad deitbene kol beta.

Even shelema massa nivne. shelema ketiv chaser yod even shelema vadday. massa deitnetil veatyay vesharyay alayyhu veitavid avidta (massa daatanetayl veavid avidta), massa deantil yadan lemebad dela middatayyhu. ketiv hacha massa uchetiv hatam (Bamidbar 10:2) ulemassa et hammachanot.
Umakkavot vehaggarzen kol kele barzel lo nishma. begin deshamir baza kolla vela ishtema milla, dela itzterichu lishar manin lemebad. vecholla beat venissa hava.

Amar rabbi shimon kamma chavivin inun mille deorayyta. zakkaa chulakeh man deitassak behu veyada lemehach (beh) beorach keshot. vehabbayit behibbanoto. kad salka biruta dekudesha berich hu lemebad yekara likareh, salka miggo machashava reuta leitpashta, veitpashtat meatar deihi machashava setima dela ityeyda.

Ad deitpashtat vesharyay leve garon atar deihu nevia tadir beraza deihu ruach chayyim. ucheden kad itpashtat hahi machashava vesharya beatar da, ikre hahi machashava elohim chayyim. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 10:10) hu elohim chayyim.

Od baa leitpashta uleitgalleya mittamman nafku esha verucha umaya kelilan kechada, venafak yaakov gevar shelim veihu kol chad denafik veishtema. mehacha machashava dehava setima bachashay ishtema leitgalya.
Od itpashtat hay machashava leitgalya. uvatash hay kol veakkish besifvavn, ucheden nafka dibbur, deashlim kolla, vegale kolla. ishtema decholla ihu hahi machashava setima dehavat lego vecholla chad.

Kevan demata itpashtuta da veitavid dibbur bitkifa dehahu kala, keden vehabbayit behibbanoto. kaasher nivna lo ketiv ella behibbanoto bechol zimna vezimna. even shelema kema deittemar. uchetiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) baatara sheitra lo immo.

Massa denafka millego vesharya venatil levar, nafka milleela vesharya venatil letatta. umakkavot vehaggarzen kol kele barzel. illen shear dargin tattain dechulhu talyayn beh vela ishtemau vela itkabbelan lego kad ihi salka leitachada leela uleyanka mittamman. veda hu behibbanoto.

Ucheden kad ihi yanka, kulhu kayyme bechedvavta veyankin veitmalyayn birchan. ucheden kayymin almin kulhu beraza chada beyichuda chad, vela have behu bechulhu almin piruda. levatar denatle chulakhon kol chad vechad kulhu mitpashtan umitparshan lesitrayyhu lema deitmannan.
Ta chaze, vayhi chol haaretz safa achat vegomer
147: Levatar ma ketiv vayhi benasam mikkedem. mehahu kadmaa dealma. vayyimtzeu bika beeretz shinar. deha mittamman mitparshan lechol inun sitrin, veihu rish malchu leitbedara.

Vei tema ha ketiv (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan umishsham yippared. vadday hachi hu dechevan denatle mittamman have piruda, vechad inun kenishin tamman leyankaa la havi piruda. vechad natlin have piruda, dichtiv vayhi benasam mikkedem vayyimtzeu bika kema deittemar.

Vayhi chol haaretz safa echat udevarim achadim deha keden alma bisoda veikkara vesharsha chada umehemnuta chada beh bekudesha berich hu. ma ketiv vayhi benasam mikkedem mikkadmaa ikkara dealma mehemnuta decholla. vayyimtzeu bika. metzia ashkachu venafku bah mittechot mehemnuta illaa (vayyimtzeu).

Ta chaze, nimrod ma ketiv beh vattehi reshit mamlachto bavel. deha mittamman netal leitachada birshu ochora. vehacha vayyimtzeu bika beeretz shinar mittamman netalu belibbayyhu leafaka mershuta illaa lirshu ochora:

Vayyomru hava nivna lanu ir umigdal verosho bashshamayim venaase lanu shem. rabbi chiyyay patach (Yeshayahu 57:20) veharshaim kayyam nigrash vegomer. vechi it yam nigrash. in, dechad yamma nafka mittikkuneh veazil (belo havela) bela chabbala, keden nigrash veitterach meatreh, keman derave chamra vela yativ al bureyeh vesalka venachata. may tama begin ki hasheket lo yuchal, veyigreshu memav refesh vetit. demafku memoy kol hahu tina deyamma vechol tinnufa lesifvavteh.

Kegavvna da inun reshaim denafka mearcha detakna veazle keravi chamra bela tikkuna, denafke meorach meshar leorach akim. may tama, begin ki hasheket lo yuchol. deha akimu dearchayyhu garim lon lemehach bela tikkuna uvela shechichu.
Vela od ella dechol rugeza didhu beshaata deamri milla mippumayyhu hahu milla refesh vetit kulhu mafke tinnufa vegiula mippumayyhu levar ad demistaave

Kumetura dehurmana memallelan belashon hakkodesh demalache hasharett ishtemodan beh vela havu memallin belishan ochora. begin kacha ketiv veatta lo yibbatztzer mehem vegomer. deilmale mishtaan belishan ochora demalache illae la havu ishtemodan beh, gara chashivu deinun chashvin lemebad. begin deovada deshedin lav ihu ella beriga chada lechezu bene enasha velo yattir.

Udevarim achadim. dehavu yadin dargin illain kol chad vechad al bureyeh velo ittechlaf lehu darga uvegin kacha ketiv udevarim achadim. uvegin kacha itteyaatu beita bisha ita dechachmeta dichtiv hava nivne lanu ir umigdal.
Kolla beraza dechachmeta hu, uvau leittakpa beara sitra ochora ulemippelach pulechana dileh. begin dehavu yadin deha kol dinin bishin mittamman nachattin lealmin. uvayayn lidchuye darga dekuddesha.

Ir umigdal, da chachmeta illaa. (davar acher deha) havu yade doshoma kaddisha la ittetakkaf beara, ella beir umigdal. ir dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 Adonai:7) (41 8) ir davd hi tziyyon vegomer. migdal dichtiv (Shir HaShirim 4:4) kemigdal david tzavvarecha. uvechachmeta avadu lemeheve shaltana desitra ochora biara dedachyay (davar acher ledachyay)  adon kol haaretz meattereh. ulemehevi diura lesitra ochora beara.

Venaase lanu shem. kema daachida (davar acher deachara) ihu shem leela, nattekif lah benono lemeheve shem beara. pen nappotz. yedia havu yadin deyittebadderun meal appe ara. uvegin kacha havu mitteyachadin lemebad avidta da bechachma.

Sitra ochora ihu dechar venukeva tukepa dezuhama dedina kashya. uchema deadam chav (beh) behu veittekappu begineh al alma. uf hachi innun avdin deittetakkaf yattir. dichtiv asher banu bene haadam. benoy deadam kadmaa deayyte veashlit sitra ochora al alma sitra visha. kema desitra dikdusha lav shaltaneh behay alma ella beir umigdal. uf hachi chashive innun lemivne ir umigdal lemishlat hay setar bisha bealma:
148: Ta chaze, vayyomru hava nivna lanu ir umigdal verosho bashshamayim. let hava ella hazemana bealma. nivne lanu ir umigdal verosho bashshamayim. kulhu beeta bisha atu lesarva beh bekudesha berich hu. bishtuta atu (ihu) betippeshu delibba.
Amar rabbi abba shetuta nesivu belibbayyhu. aval bechachma dirshiu atu begin lenafka mershu illaa lirshu ochora uleachlafa yekareh likara nucheraa. uvecholla it raza dechachmeta illaa.

Hava nivna lanu ir umigdal. ta chaze, kad matu lehay bika deihu reshu nucheraa veitgeli lehu atar deshaltenuta da tekia bego nune yamma. amru ha atar lemetav uleittakfa libba leithannaa beh tattae. miyyad hava nivna lanu ir. natkin beatar da ir umigdal.

Venaase lanu shem. atar da (yahiv lon) yehe lan ledachala vela ochora, venivne leatar da ir umigdal. lamma lan lesalka leela dela nechol leithannaa minnah. ha hacha atar metakna. venaase lanu shem dachala lemiflach tamman. pen nafutz ledargin ochoranin venitbaddar lesitre alma:

Nachatt hay shema dekaddisha lemechezi (al) ovadehon devinyayno devanu. veinnun havu memallelan bilshon kodesh legabbe kol innun dargin kaddishin vehavu matztzelichin. kevan denachattatt kedusha ittebalbelu kol innun dargin. illain nachattu vetattain seliku. vela havu kayymin beorach meshar kema dehavu. ulevattar bilbel lishanhon be lishan veittebaddaru lechol sitre alma.

Chad memanna hu birkia uveh kayymin kol (davar acher 33 innun) mappetchan deovade alma. vihu kayyma zammin beshaatte verige deyoma. veinnun havu yadin beraza dechachmeta ginza dehay memanna. vehavu patteche vesagre umatztzelche beovadehon bememra depumehon. kevan (daasatekalea) deittebalbal memra dilhon, kolla ittemna minnayyhu.

Vaattar metukkan ashkachu behahu bika. sitra desitrin: vayyimtztzeu bika. attar metukkan lehay (davar acher 33 hahu) sitra bisha devau innun leattekappa veittemnau. tukepa (dileh) dehahu sitra hava talya leittepraa behahi bika ad denatla tamman chelin umashiryayn kegavvna deinnun devanu karta umigdela veitteyhivu (kolla) kulhu bidaha. veittekatalu tamman
Innun dolo bau lemeppak beketz hayyamin. ittebhilu venappelu beketz hayyamim. behahu attar deittechallash tukpa bekadmitta behay bika. veal da ketiv, (Yechezkel 36) vehi melea atztzamott.
Veittetakpatt behahu tzulema deakim nevuchadnetztzar. veittebar tukepa levattar beinnun garmin uvehahu tzulema. deinnun kadmae kayymu vkamu al raglehon. vehahu tzulema ittebar.

Ucheden yadu kol ammin dealma delett eloah bar kudesha bericha hu bilchodoy. vtu deittekaddash shemeh al yeda dechananya mishael vaazarya vecholla bechad yoma. veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 29:23) vehikdishu ett kedosh yaakov vegomer, (74 kan sitre tora)

Vayyered Adonai lirot et hair veet hammigdal da hu chad meinnun eser zimnin denachata shechinta leara. vechi ma hu lirot vela hava yada mikkadmat dena. ella lirot leashgacha bedina kema deat amer, (Shemot Adonai:21) yere Adonai alechem veyishpot.

Et hair veet hammigdal. hacha it leistakkala. deha la ketiv lirot et bene haadam. ella lirot et hair veet hammigdal. ammay. ella beshaata deashgach kudesha berich hu bedina, bekadmita yashgach bedarga dilela, ulevatar bedarga diltatta. bekadmita beillae ulevatar betattae. uvegin dehay milla mata leela, ashgachuta dilela hava beh bekadmita dichtiv lirot et hair veet hammigdal.
Asher banu bene haadam. may bene haadam benoy deadam kadmaa demarad bemareh vegaram mota lealma. asher banu bene haadam binyayna vadday amru (garmu) uvau lemivni leela.
Rabbi shimon patach (veamar) (Yechezkel 46:1) ko amar Adonai elohim shaar
149: Hechatzer happenimit happone kadim yihye sagur sheshet yeme hammaase uveyom hashshabbat yippateach uveyom hachodesh yippateach. hay kera it leistakkala beh. veihu raza kema deittemar. yihye sagur sheshet yeme hammaase. ammay (uveyom hashshabbat yiftach uveyom hachodesh yiftach vegomer. amay yihye sagur kol innun yomin dasheshat yeme hammaase).

Ella ilen yeme chol. detara da yihye sagur dela leishtammasha chol bekudesha. uveyom hashshabbat yippateach uveyom hachodesh yippateach. deha keden shimmusha (dekudesha berich hu) dekudesha bekudesha. ucheden itnehir sihara leitchabbera beshimsha.
Ta chaze, tara da la itpattach beinnun shitta yome dechol. begin deha beinnun yome dechol alma tattaa ittezan veshaltin kol innun shit yomin dechol al alma bar beara deyisrael.

Veinnun deshalte la shalte beara kaddisha begin dehashshaar hazze ihu sagur. aval beyom hashshabbat uveyom hachodesh kulhu mitabberan vela shaltin begin dehashshaar hazze ihu patuach vealma ihu bechedva veittezan mittamman vela ityeyhiv alma lirshu ochora.

Vei tema dechol innun shit yomin innun shaltin bilchodayyhu. ta chaze, happone kadim. ad la yekumun leshaltaa ihu istakkal tadir bealma. aval la itpattach leitzena alma mikkudesha bar beyoma deshabbatta uveyoma dechadsha. vechulhu yomin kulhu itdabbekan beyoma deshabbatta veitzenu mittamman. deha (davar acher 33 keden) beyoma deshabbatta kulhu tarin petichan venayycha ishtechach lecholla leillae vetattae. ta chaze, vayyered Adonai lirot. nachat mikkudesha lechol (varedayd perisha) leashgacha bamme debanu vekayymu kiyyuma leatara al alma ledachala lon.

Rabbi yitzchak hava yativ kammeh derabbi shimon. amar leh ma chamu illen deavadu shetuta da lemarda beh bekudesha berich hu vechulhu beeta chada itkayymu beda. amar leh ha ittemar dichtiv vayhi benasam mikkedem itnetilu meela letatta. itnetilu meara deyisrael venachatu levaval. amru ha hacha atar lemidbak.

Venaase lanu shem vegomer veyitdabbak siyyua diltatta beatar da. begin dechad dina ate leashraa bealma, ha atar da lekovleh. umehacha ithanne alma veyittezan. deha leela dechiku ihu leitzena alma minneh. vela od ella anan nissak lirkia venaggach beh kerava dela yechot (beh) tofana bealma kedivkadmita:

Vayyomer Adonai hen am echad vesafa achat lechullam. begin dechulhu kechada, beyichuda dechulhon yaavdun veyitzlechun beovadayyhu. yitbadderun dargin kol chad lesitreh. uvegin kach yitbadderun kol hanne diltatta. ma ketiv vayyafetz Adonai otam mishsham.

Vei tema lishanhon ammay itbalbel (itbaddar uvilbel lon kudesha berich hu). ella begin dechulhon memallelin bilshon hakkodesh. hahu lishna ka avid lon siyyua. begin divovada uvemillula defuma talyayn millin illen leadbeka kavvana delibba. uveda avde siyyua lehahu atar devae leakama.

Veal da itbalbal lishanhon dela yachilu leittakkafa reutehon bilshon hakkodesh. kevan deitchallaf lishanhon la atzlachu beovada (29 1 462) begin dechela dilela la yade vela ishtemode bar bilshon hakkodesh. vechad itbalbal lishna dilhon itchallash chelehon veitbar tukefa dilhon.

Ta chaze, deha milla (da) deamre tattae bilshon hakkodesh, kulhu chele shemaya yade beh veittakfe beh. velishan ochora la yadin vela ishtemode beh. veal da illen kevan deitbalbal lishana dilhon, miyyad vayyachdelu livnot hair. deha itbar chelayyhu vela yachilu lemebad midde biruta dilhon.

(Daniel 2:20) leheve shemeh (di elaha) (dekudesha berich hu) mevarach min alma vead alma, di chachmeta ugevurata di lehhi. deha begin (da) deanchit kudesha berich hu raze dechachmeta lealma, itkkalkalu beh bene nasha uvau leitgara beh.
Yahav chachmeta illaa leadam harishon, uvehahi chachma
150: Deitgele leh yada dargin, veitdevak beyetzer hara, ad deistalleku minneh mabbue dechachmeta. ulevatar tav kamme mareh, veitgalleyayn leh minnayyhu vela kekadmita. levatar behahu sifra dileh yada chachman. ulevatar atu bene nasha veargizu kammeh.

Yahav chachmeta lenoach ufelach bah lekudesha berich hu, levatar ma ketiv vayyesht min hayyayyin vayyishkar vayyitgal kema deittemar. yahav chachmeta leavraham ufelach bah lekudesha berich hu. levatar nafak minneh yishmael deargiz kamme kudesha berich hu. vechen yitzchak nafak minneh esav. yaakov nesav teren achatan.

Yahav chachmeta lemoshe ma ketiv beh (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu. vela hava kemoshe shammash meheman bechulhu dargin vela sata libbeh betiuveta dechad minnayyhu. ella kaim bimhemnuta illaa kedka yeut.

Yahav chachmeta illaa lishlomo malka. levatar ma ketiv beh (Mishlei 1:1) mishle shelomo (Mishlei 30:1) hammassa neum haggever leitiel leitiel veuchol. amar shelomo itti el vechachmeta dileh hu. veuchol veechul lemebad reuti. levatar (Melachim 1 18) vayyakem Adonai satan lishlomo vegomer.

Ta chaze, begin zeiru dechachmeta deashkachu illen mehahu chachma dekadmae, itgaru beh bekudesha berich hu, uvanu migdal veavadu kol ma deavadu. ad deitbaddaru meanpe ara vela ishtaar behu chachma lemebad midde.

Aval lezimna deate kudesha berich hu yitar chachmeta bealma veyiflechun leh bah hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 36:27) veet ruchi etten bekirbechem veasiti. lav kekadmae dechavilu beh alma. ella veasiti et asher bechukkay telechu veet mishpatay tishmeru vaasitem.

Rabbi yose verabbi chiyyay havu azle bearcha. amar leh rabbi yose lerabbi chiyyay niftach beorayyta venema milla. patach rabbi yose veamar (Devarim 23:15) ki Adonai elohecha mithallech bekerev machancha lehatztzilcha velatet oyvecha lefanecha vehaya machneycha kadosh velo yire vecha ervat davar veshav meacharecha. ki Adonai elohecha mithallech, mehallech mibbae leh. ella kema deat amer (Bereshit 3:8) mithallech baggan leruach hayyom. veda hu ilana deachal minneh adam harishon. mithallech nukeva mehallech dechar.

Veda hu deazil kammayyhu deyisrael kad havu azle bemadbera dichtiv (Shemot 13:21) vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam vegomer. hu deazil kammeh debar nash kad azil bearcha. dichtiv, (Tehillim 85:14) tzedek lefanav yehallech veyasem lederech peamav. veda hu deazil kammeh debar nash beshaata deihu zache. velamma. lehatztzilcha velatet oyvecha lefanecha. leishtezava bar nash bearcha vela yishlot beh ochora.

Uvegin kach libbae leh lebar nash leistammera mechovoy uledakkaa legarmeh. may dachyu da. dichtiv, (Devarim 23:15) vehaya machanecha kadosh. may kadosh, kedoshim mibbae leh. ella machanecha kadosh illen shayyfe gufa degufa itchabbar veittakkan behu. uvegin kach vehaya machanycha kadosh. velo yire vecha ervat davar.

May ervat davar. da milleta (areyytaa) deeryayn. deda hu milla dekudesha berich hu mais bah yattir mikkolla. kevan deamar velo yire vecha ervat, ammay davar. ella hanni chayyayve alma degaale umesaave garmayyhu bemilla dilhon denafke mippumayyhu veha ihu ervat davar.

Vechol kach lamma. begin deihu azil kammach. vei at avid keden, miyyad veshav meacharecha, dela yezil bahadach veyetuv meacharecha. veanan ha azlinan kammeh bearcha nitassek bemille deorayyta. deha orayyta itattera al resheh devar nash ushechinta la aadiat minneh.

Patach rabbi chiyyay veamar vayyomer Adonai hen am echad vesafa achat lechullam vegomer ta chaze, ma ketiv vayhi benasam mikkedem. may mikkedem. mikkadmono shel olam. vayyimtzeu. vayyiru mibbae leh may vayyimtzeu. ella metzia ashkachu tamman meraze dechachmeta mikkadmae deitnear tamman min bene tofana, uvah ishtadlu lemebad behahi avidta deavadu lesarva beh bekudesha berich hu, vehavu amre befuma veavde
151: Chame ma ketiv hen am echad vesafa achat lechullam. begin deinnun belibba chad ureuta chad umemallele bilshon hakkodesh. veatta lo yibbatzer mehem kol asher yazmu laasot. velet man deyimna ovada dilhon. aval may aavid, avalbel lon dargin dilela, velishan dilhon letatta. ucheden itmena ovada dilhon.

Uma begin dehavu biruta velibba chad umemallele bilshon hakkodesh ketiv lo yibbatzer mehem kol asher yazmu laasot, vedina dilela la yachil leshaltaa behu. anan o chavrayay demitassekin beorayyta, veanan belibba chad ureuta chad, al achat kamma vechamma.

Amar rabbi yose mikkan leinnun mare demachloket let lon kiyyuma. deha kol zimna (deillen) divne alma illen im illen biruta chada velibba chad, af al gav demarde beh bekudesha berich hu, la shalta behu dina dilela. kevan deitpallegu miyyad vayyafetz Adonai otam mishsham vegomer.

Amar rabbi chiyyay ishtema decholla bemilla defuma talyay. deha kevan deitbalbel miyyad vayyafetz Adonai otam mishsham. aval bezimna deate ma ketiv, (Tzefanya 3:9) ki az ehefoch el ammim safa verura likro kullam beshem Adonai uleavdo shechem echad uchetiv, (Zecharya 14:9) vehaya Adonai lemelech al kol haaretz bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen:
Sitre tora tona betukepa dehurmanu demalka, antztziv chad ilana rabba vetakkif go netian ilain, netia ilana da, bitteresar techumin istachar, bearba sitrin dealma perisa ragleh.
Tk parse matlanoy, kol reuttin deinnun parsin beh talyayn, kad ittear hay, kulhu mittearin bahadeh lett man denappik merutteh levattar, kulhu birutta chada bahadeh,

Kam milleela (sefer acher nachit) ittenachitt bematlanoy lego yamma. minneh yamma (itgeli) ittemalyay. ihu mekora (dechol davar acher lechol) mayin denavin. techotteh mittepallegin kol memoy divreshitt, shakyu deginta beh talyayn.

Kol nishmetin dealma minnih parchin. nishmetin illen alin beginta lenachatta lehay alma. nishmatta kad nappeka ittebarcha beshevo birchan lemeheve abba (davar acher 33 lerucha vedam) leguppa (ulemeheve) bisliku (dediyyukena illaa hada hu dichtiv vayyomer Adonai el avram ha nishmeta illaa abba 2 legufa bisliku) dediukeno illaa.
Kad baya (nafsha) lenachatta lehay alma, ome lah kudesha bericha hu lemitar pikkude orayyta ulemebad reutteh. umasar lah mea mappetchan
152: Leh avraham mikkol bene darih dehavu abbire lev veinnun rechokim mitztzedaka kema deittemar.

Rabbi yose patach (Tehillim 84:2) ma yedidot mishkenotecha Adonai tzevaot. kamma it lon livni nasha leistakkala befulechana dekudesha berich hu. deha kol bene nasha la yade vela mistakkele al ma kaim alma. veinnun al ma kayymin. dechad bera kudesha berich hu alma avad shemaya meesh umimmayim mitarvin kechada vela havu galde. ulevatar aglidu vekayymu berucha illaa umittamman shatil alma, lekayyma al samchin, veinnun samchin la kayymin ella behahu rucha, uveshaata dehahu rucha istallak kulhu meraffin vezain vealma irtat hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 9:6) hammargiz eretz mimkomah veammudeha yitpallatzun. vecholla kaim al orayyta, dechad yisrael mishtaddele beorayyta mitkayyem alma veinnun kayymin vesamchin kayymin beatrayyhu bekiyyuma shelim.

Ta chaze, beshaata deitar palgut lelya vekudesha berich hu al leginta deeden leishtashea im tzaddikaya, kulhu ilanin divginta deeden mezammeran umeshabbechan kammeh. dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 16:33) az yerannenu atze hayyaar millifne Adonai vegomer.

Vecharoza kare vechayil veamar lechon amrin kaddishin elyonin, man minchon deayil rucha beudenoy lemishma, veenoy pekichin lemecheme. velibbeh patuach leminda, beshaata derucha dechol ruchin arim besimu denishmata, umittamman nafik kala dekalaya, cheylin itbaddar learba sitre alma.

(Umoladtecha da gufa deitkere ilana dechayye deihu teresar shivtin illain. umibbet avicha da shechinta. avicha da kudesha berich hu. shenneemar 0 gozel aviv veimmo veomer en pesha vegomer. veen aviv ella kudesha berich hu veen immo ella keneset yisrael. el haaretz asher arekka da ihu hay alma), (nusach acher umoladtecha da ilana dechayye, umibbet avicha teresar techumin shivtin illain. el haaretz asher arekka da ihu hay alma), (74 kan sitre tora)
153: Kad istaav gufa, venishmata shatya al anpe deavira detihara, vesalka venachata, vetarin la mitpattechan, mitgalgelan keavnin bego kusefita. vavy lon man yitba lon, dela yekumun beidduna da bego duchete deinnuge detzaddikaya, itpakdun duchetayyhu. itmasserun bida deduma, nachate vela salke. alayyhu ketiv, (Iyov 7:9) kala anan vayyelach ken yored sheol lo yaale.

Behahi shaata itar shalhova chad missetar tzafon uvatash bearba sitre alma venachit umate ben gadfe detarnegola veitar hahu shalhova beh vekare, velet man deitar bar innun zakkae keshot dekayyme veitaru beorayyta. ucheden kudesha berich hu vechol innun tzaddikayay divgo ginta deeden tzayyte lekalehon. kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 8:13) hayyoshevet baggannim chaverim makshivim lekolech hashshemiini:

Vayyomer Adonai el avram, ma ketiv leela (Bereshit 11:28) vayyamat haran al pene terach aviv vegomer. may irya hacha, ella ad hahu yoma la hava bar nash demit bechayye avoy bar da, vechad itreme avram lenura itketil haran, uvegin da nafku mittamman man katil lon leharan, ella kevan deramu avraham lenura dekassedae, itgeli aleh kudesha berich hu ushezaveh, vehava haran achuy kae tamman. amru kassedae vegin zechuteh deharan ishteziv, miyyad nafak shalhova deesha veokdeh leharan, hada hu dichtiv vayyamat haran al peni terach aviv. veit deamre zara deterach let esha shalta beh, aval nerame leharan lenura, vei la ittokad neda bevadday dela shalta nura bezare, miyyad rami leh leharan lenura veittokd vehava terach avoy kaim tamman hada hu dichtiv vayyamat haran al pene terach aviv. behahu yoma yadu kol umaya velishnaya dela shezveh leavraham ella kudesha berich hu deihu yechidai dealma, vehavu mayyten benayyhu lemishkeneh deavraham veamrin leh chaminan lach, deat rachitz bekudesha berich hu deihu ribboneh dealma, olif levanana meorchach deat yeda, vealayyhu amar kera (Tehillim 47:10) nedive ammim neesafu am elohe avraham).

Ta chaze, ma ketiv vayyikkach terach et avram beno veet lot ben haran vegomer. vayyetzu ittam meur kasdim. vayyetzu ittam, itto mibbae leh. deha ketiv vayyikkach terach vegomer may vayyetzu ittam. ella terach velot im avraham vesara nafku deinnun havu ikkera lemeppak miggo innun chayyayvayya, dechevan dechama terach deavraham bereh ishteziv miggo nura, ithaddar lemebad reuteh deavraham, uvegin kach vayyetzu ittam terach velot.

Uveshaata denafku ma ketiv lalechet artza kenaan. diruta dilhon hava lemehach tamman. mikkan olifna kol man deitar leitdakkaa mesayyin leh. ta chaze, dehachi hu dechevan dichtiv lalechet artza kenaan miyyad vayyomer Adonai el avram lech lecha, vead deihu itar bekadmita la ketiv lech lecha.

Ta chaze, mila dilela la itar ad deitar letatta bekadmita al ma detishre hahi dilela, veraza demilla, nehora uchema la itachid binhora chivvavra ad deihi itarit bekadmita, kevan deihi itarit bekadmita, miyyad nehora chivvra sharyay alah.

Veal da ketiv (Tehillim 83:2) elohim al dami lach al techerash veal tishkot el. begin dela yitpesak nehora chivvavra mealma lealmin. vechen (Yeshayahu 62:6) hammazkirim et Adonai al domi lachem. begin leatara letatta bemma deyishre itaruta dilela. vechen kevan deitar bar nash itaruta bekadmita keden itar itaruta dilela. ta chaze, kevan dichtiv vayyetzu ittam meur kasdim vegomer miyyad vayyomer Adonai el avram vegomer.

Vayyomer Adonai el avram lech lecha, amar rabbi elazar lech lecha, legarmach leatkana garmach, (leittakkefa) leatkana darga dilach. lech lecha, let ant (sefer acher keday) lemekam hacha ben chayyayvin illen.
154: Deha kudesha berich hu yahiv leh leavraham rucha dechachmeta, vehava yada umetzaref (tzinnore) sitre deyishuve alma, veistakkal behu veatkal betikla veyada chelin di memannan al sitre yishuva.
Kad mata lego nekuda deemtzaita deyishuva takil betikla vela hava salik beyadeh. ashgach leminda chela di memanna alah vela yachil leitdabbeka biruteh,
Takil kamma zimnin vechama deha mittamman ishtil kol alma, ashgach vetzaraf vetakal leminda vechama deha chela illaa dealah let leh shiura amik vesatim velav ihu kegavvne desitre darge deyishshuva.

Ashgach vetakil veyada deha kemma demehahi nekuda emtzaita deyishshuva minneh ishtil kol alma lechol sitroy. hachi name yada deha chela deshare alah mittamman nafku kol shear chelin dimmanan al kol sitre alma, vechulhu beh achidan. keden (Bereshit 11:31) vayyetzu ittam meur kasdim lalechet artza kenaan.

Od ashgach vetakil vetzarif lemekam al berira demilla dehahu atar vela hava yada vela yachil lemekam alah leitdabbeka, kevan dechama tukefa dehay atar vela yachil lemekam aleh miyyad vayyavou ad charan vayyeshvu sham.

May tama deavraham. ella deihu hava yada vetzarif bechol innun shaltanin medabbere alma bechol sitro deyishshuva, vehava takil vetzarif innun deshaltin besitre deyishshuva medabbere kochvaya umazzalehon, man innun takkifin illen al illen, vehava takil kol yishshuve dealma (velo) vehava salik bidoy. kad mata lehay atar chama takkifu deamikin vela yachil lemekam beh.
Kevan dechama kudesha berich hu itaruta dileh vetiuveta dileh. miyyad itgeli aleh veamar leh lech lecha. leminda lach uleatkana garmach.

Meartzecha, mehahu sitra deyishshuva dehavit mitdabbak beh. umimmoladtecha, mehahu chachma deat mashgach vetakil toldata dilach veriga veshaata vezimna deityeylidat beh uvehahu kochava uvehahu mazzala.
Umibbet avicha, dela tashgach beveta deavuch. vei it lach sharsha leatzlacha bealma mibbeta deavuch, begin kach lech lecha mechachma da umeashgachuta da.

Ta chaze, dehachi hu, deha nafku meur kasdim vehavu becharan, ammay yema leh lech lecha meartzecha umimmoladtecha. ella ikkera demilleta kema deittemar. el haaretz asher arekka. arekka ma dela yechilat lemekam aleh vela yechilat leminda chela dehahi ara deihu amik vesatim:

Veeescha legoy gadol vegomer veeescha, begin dichtiv lech lecha. vaavarachekka, begin dichtiv meartzecha. vaagaddela shemecha, begin dichtiv umimmoladtecha. vehye beracha, begin dichtiv umibbet avicha.

Rabbi shimon amar veeescha legoy gadol missitra deyamina. vaavarachekka missitra dismala vaagaddela shemecha missitra deemtzaita. vehye beracha missitra deara deyisrael. ha hacha kurseyay dearba samchin dechulhu kelilan beh beavraham, mikkan ulehala birchan leacharine demittezne mehacha dichtiv vaavarcha mevarachecha

Sitre tora veeescha legoy gadol hay birketa chada, vaavarechcha teren, vaagaddela shemecha telatt, vehye beracha arba. vaavarcha mevarachecha chamesh, umekallelcha aor shitt. venivrechu vecha kol mishpechott haadama ha sheva. kevan deittebarchu beillen sheva birchan, ma ketiv vayyelecha avram kaasher dibber elav Adonai lenachatta lehay alma kema deittepakda.

Miyyad vayyelecha itto lot. da ihu nachash deittelatya veittelatya alma begineh deihu kaim lepittecha leastaa leguppa, velo tippeol nishmatta pulechana deittepakdatt ad deyaavrun alah behay alma 13 shenin, deha mitteresar shenin uleela nishmatta ittearatt lemippelach pulechano deittepakdatt hada hu dichtiv.
155: Umekallelcha aor venivrechu vecha kol mishpechot haadama.

Rabbi elazar hava yativ kammeh derabbi shimon avoy, vehave imeh rabbi yehuda verabbi yitzchak verabbi chizkiyya. amar leh rabbi elazar lerabbi shimon avoy, hay dichtiv lech lecha meartzecha umimmoladtecha, kevan dechulhu nafku lemehach, ammay la ittemar leh dechulhu yifkun.

Deha af al gav deterach hava pelach leavoda zara. kevan deitar beitaruta tav lemefak bahadeh deavraham, vechaminan dekudesha berich hu itrae bityuveta dechayyayvaya ushera lemefak ammay la ketiv lechu lachem, ammay leavraham bilchodoy lech lecha.

Amar leh rabbi shimon, i tema deterach kad nafak meur kasdim begin leahadara bitshuva hava, lav hachi. ella kad nafak leishtezava nafak, dehavu kulhu bene areh baan lemikteleh. kevan dechazu deishteziv avraham havu amre leh leterach, ant hu dehavit mate lan beillen pesilin, umiggo dachala dilhon nafak terach, kevan demata lecharan la nafak mittamman levatar, dichtiv vayyelech avram kaasher dibber elav Adonai vayyelech itto lot, veilu terach la ketiv (beh vayyelech, ella vayyetze).

Patach veamar (Iyov 38:15) vayyimna mershaim oram uzeroa ramma teshabber. hay kera ukemuha, aval vayyimna mershaim oram, da nimrod uvene dareh denafak avraham minnayyhu dehava oram. uzeroa ramma teshabber, da nimrod.

Davar acher vayyimna mershaim oram, da terach uvene veteh. oram, da avraham. haor la ketiv ella oram dehava immehon. uzeroa ramma teshabber, da nimrod dehava mate avatreh kol bene alma, uvegin kach ketiv lech lecha. begin leanhara lach ulechol innun deyifkun minach mikkan ulehala.

Tu patach veamar, (Iyov 37:21) veatta lo rau or bahir hu bashshechakim veruach avra vattetaharem. veatta lo rau or, ematay, beshaata deamar kudesha berich hu leavraham lech lecha meartzecha umimmoladtecha umibbet avicha. bahir hu bashshechakim. devaa kudesha berich hu leadbaka leh leavraham behahu or dilela uleanhara tamman.

Veruach avra vattetaharem. deha levatar tavu bityuveta terach vechol bene veteh (nusach acher vechol bene mateh). bene veteh (nusach acher bene mateh) dichtiv veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan. terach, dichtiv veatta tavo el avotecha beshalom vegomer.
Veavram ben chamesh shanim veshivim shana. sheva vechamesh teresar innun (uteren illain alayyhu arba sere innun).
Ucheden ittechaziatt nishmatta behay alma. deihi atteya mechamosh shanim deinnun tk parse deilana dechayye. veshivim shana da ihu hahu ilana mammash deihu sheviaa ledargin veshivin shana ittekre.

Keden nappekatt mehahu zuhama denachash vealatt bepulechana kaddisha hada hu dichtiv betztzetto mecharan (yeme 70 355 lo sefurot chayyim mehahu arba sere) mehahu rugeza vetukepa dehahu (satan) nachash dehava aste leh ad hasheta leguppa veshalta aloy.

Beilana shalta arla telatt shenin. bevar nash telatt sare shenin deikrun shene arla, kevan deaavaru al guppa innun shenin veitteavratt (davar acher veatarat) nishmatta lemippelach pulechana kaddisha, pekidatt leguppa lirutta tava, lichpof lehahu nachash deha la yachil

Vayyelecha avram kaasher dibber elav Adonai. amar rabbi elazar ta chaze, deha la ketiv vayyetze avram kaasher dibber elav Adonai. ella vayyelech. kema deat amer lech lecha, deha yetzia bekadmita avdu dichtiv vayyetzu ittam meur kasdim lalechet artza kenaan, vehasheta ketiv vayyelech vela ketiv vayyetze.

Kaasher dibber elav Adonai, deavtach leh bechulhu havetachot. vayyelech itto lot, deitchabbar immeh begin lemelaf meovadoy, veim kol da la olif kule hay. amar rabbi elazar zakkain innun tzaddikayyay deolfe archoy dekudesha berich hu begin lemehach behu uledachala minneh mehahu yoma dedina dezammin bar nash lemehav dina vechushebana lekudesha berich hu.
Patach veamar, (Iyov 37:7) beyad kol adam yachtom ladaat kol anshe maasehu hay kera ukemuha. aval
156: Dichtiv vayyikkach avram ett saray ishto vegomer (avram da 10 et sare da Adonai. 10 da nishmeta lenishmeta vehu zachar. Adonai da nishmeta denukeba). da guppa, deihi legabbe nishmatta kenukeva legabbe dechura. veett lot ben achiv da (yetzer hara) nachash dolo aade kol kacha min guppa, begin devekutta deguppa la aadiu kol kacha (zimna hahu) minneh, aval ittearutta denishmatta alke leh tadir veattere beh veochach leh vechappif leh al karcheh vela yachil leshaltaa.

Veett kol rechusham asher rachashu illen ovadin tavin deavid bar nash behay alma beittearutta denishmatta. veett hannepesh asher oshu vecharan, hahu nepesh dehavatt bidvekutta bekadmitta bechavrutta dehahi arla bahade guppa veattekin lah levattar, deha levattar dittelesar shenin uleela denishmatta ittearatt leattekana leguppa, tarvavyyhu metakkenin lehahu nepesh demishtattepa betukepa denachash utteuveteh bisha hada hu dichtiv veett hanneposh asher asu vecharan.

Veim kol da nishmeta attekeppatt beh behahu nachash letabbera leh betukepa beshibudo ditteshuva (nusach acher beshibuda deorayyta, veamshich leh legabbe batte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot begin dela yitgabber al rucha kidbekadmeta) hada hu dichtiv vyyaavor (hakkatuv baddaf 80 achar hagelayvan shura 15) (74 kan sitre tora)

Ta chaze behahu yoma deashlimu yomoy devar nash leafaka mealma, hahu yoma degufa itbar venafsha baya leitparsha minneh, keden ityeyhiv reshu levar nash lemecheme ma dela hava leh reshu lemecheme bezimna degufa shalta vekaim al bureyeh.
Ucheden kayyme aleh telat shelichan vechashve yomoy vechovoy vechol ma deavad behay alma, vehu ode al kolla befumeh, ulevatar hu chatim aleh bideh, hada hu dichtiv beyad kol adam yachtom,

Uvideh kulhu chatimin lemedan leh (behahu davar acher behay) alma al kadmae veal batrae al chadte veal attike la itneshe chad minnayyhu, hada hu dichtiv ladaat kol anshe maasehu. vechol innun ovadin deavad behay alma begufa verucha hachi name yahiv chushebna beguppa verucha ad la yippuk mealma.

Ta chaze, kama dechayyayvaya akshe kedal behay alma hachi name afillu beshata devae lenafka mehay alma akshe kedal. vegin kach zakkaa hu bar nash deyalif behay alma archoy dekudesha berich hu begin lemehach behu. vechayyayva af al gav deistakkal behanne (nusach acher deishtaddal bahade) tzaddikayay akshe kedal vela bae lemelaf.
Uvegin kach it leh letzaddika lemitkaf beh veaf al gav dechayyayva akshe kedal hu la yishbok leh veit leh leatkafa bideh vela yishbok leh, dei yishbok leh yehach veyachariv alma.

Ta chaze, min elisha dedacha legechazi. vechen beavraham kol zimna dehava lot bahadeh la itchabbar bahade rashshiayya, kevan deitperash minneh ma ketiv vayyivchar lo lot et kol kikkar hayyarden, uchetiv vayeehal ad sedom. ma ketiv batreh veanshe sedom raim vechattaim laAdonai meod.

Amar rabbi abba hay deamart vayyelech avram vela ketiv vayyetze avram shappir hu. aval sofa dikra ma ketiv betzeto mecharan. amar rabbi elazar mecharan ketiv vehahi yetzia meeretz moladto havat bekadmita:

Vayyikkach avram et saray ishto. mahu vayyikkach, ella amshich lah bemille maalyayta, begin delet leh reshu lebar nash leafaka itteteh lemehach beara ochora bela reuta dilah. vechen hu omer (Bamidbar 20:25) kach et aharon (Bamidbar 3:45) kach et haleviyim. uvegin kach vayyikkach avram mashich lah bemillin veoda lah archehon deinnun beni dara kamma bishin. uvegin kach vayyikach avram et saray ishto.

Veet lot ben achiv. ma chama avraham ledavka immeh lot, ella begin detzafa beruach hakkodesh dezammin lemeppak minneh david. veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan. illen gerim vegiyyorot deatkinu nafshayyhu, avraham megayyer guverin vesara megayyeret nashin umaale alehon keillu avdu lehon.
Amar rabbi abba i hachi kamma bene nasha havu, i tema dechulhu azlu immeh. amar rabbi elazar in. (uvegin kullehu davar acher uvegin kach kullehu) bene nasha dehavu azlin immeh kulhu ikrun
157: Am elohe avraham. vehava maavar beara vela hava dachil dichtiv vayyaavor avram baaretz.

Amar leh rabbi abba i hava ketiv vehannefesh asher asu vecharan hava amina hachi, ella veet hannefesh ketiv, et leasgaa zechuta dechulhu nafshan dehavu azle immeh, dechol man dimzakke leochora hahu zechuta talya beh vela aade minneh, menalan dichtiv veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan, zechuta deinnun nafshan hava azil immeh deavraham. lech lecha.

Amar rabbi shimon may tama degilluya kadmaa deitgele kudesha berich hu aleh deavraham patach belech lecha, deha ad hacha la mallil immeh kudesha berich hu, may tama patach lech lecha. ella ha kaamru deramaz bechushebnih mea deha lemea shenin ityeylid leh bar.

Aval ta chaze, kol ma deavid kudesha berich hu beara kolla raza dechachmeta ihu, begin deavraham la hava davik beh bekudesha berich hu keden kedka chaze, amar leh lech lecha, veda remez lehahu atar devae leitkerava bahadeh dekudesha berich hu, veihu darga kadmaa leoola lekudesha berich hu, begin kach lech lecha.

Vehay darga la yachil avraham leitachada beh ad deyeul leara detamman yekavel leh lehahu darga, kegavvna da ketiv, (Shmuel 2 2:1) vayyishal david baAdonai lemor haeele beachat meare yehuda vayyomer Adonai ale vayyomer ana eele vayyomer chevrona. vechi kevan demit shaul umalchuta itchaze ledavid ammay la kabbil malchuta miyyad al kol yisrael.

Ella kolla raza dechachmeta ihu, begin dedavid let leh lekabbela malchuta ella ad deyitchabbar baavahan deinnun bechevron ucheden behu yekabbel malchuta. veal da itakkav tamman sheva shenin begin dikabbel malchuta kedka yeut vecholla beraza dechachmeta uvegin ditakken malchuteh. kegavvna da avraham la al bekiyyuma dekudesha berich hu ad deal leara.

Chame ma ketiv vayyaavor avram baaretz. vayyaavor vayyelech mibbae leh, ela hacha hu remez shema kaddisha deitchattim beh alma bev atvavn gelifan dechulhu bishma da. ketiv hacha vayyaavor uchetiv hatam (Shemot la) vayyaavor Adonai al panav vayyikra:
Besifra derabbi yesa sava ketiv hacha vayyaavor avram baaretz uchetiv hatam (Shemot 33:19) ani aavir kol tuvi. vehu remez likdusha deara deate meatar illaa kedka chaze.

Ad mekom shechem ad elon more. missitra da (davar acher 33 diltatta). lesitra da kedka chaze. vehakkenaani az baaretz. ha ittemar dead keden shalta chivya bisha deitlatya veayyte levavtin al alma dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:25) arur kenaan eved avadim yihye leechav uchetiv, (Bereshit 50) arur atta mikkol habbehema vegomer. vetamman itkeriv avraham legabbe kudesha berich hu. ma ketiv vayyera Adonai el avram hacha itgeli leh ma dela hava yada hahu chela amika leshalta al ara. uvegin kach vayyera ma

Sitre tora (147 74 vayyaavor hu gillayon) kudesha bericha hu ramiz chachmeta illaa beavraham uveyitztzechak, avraham da nishmatta lenishmatta veihi (sefer acher av veram), neshama da hi sara. lot da hu nachash uvatt zugeh dehahu samael. ruach kaddisha da yitztzechak. nepesh kaddisha da rivka. yetztzer hara da ruach habbehema, veal da amar shelomo bechachmatteh (Kohelet 3:21) mi yodea ruach bene haadam haola hi vegomer nepesh habbahamitt da nepesh missitra deyetztzer hara.

Veal da amru (nusach acher dehahu) deihi nishmatta lenishmatta itteara legavra beyira uvechachmeta, nishmatta itteara leinish bevina, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 28:28) vayyomer laadam hen yiratt Adonai hi chachma vegomer. nishmatta itteore bitteshuva deittekre bina veikre sara. veruach hu hakkol veittekre daatt veitteore leinish di salik kaleh beorayyta, veittekre tora shebbichtav, venpesh hasichlitt ittear minneh ovadin tavin.
158: Ucheden vayyiven sham mizbeach laAdonai hannire elav, kevan deamar laAdonai mahu hannire elav. ella hacha itgeli leh hahu darga deshalta al ara veal beh veitkeyyaym beh:

Vayyatek mishsham hahara. mittamman yada har Adonai. vechulhu dargin dintiin behay atar. vayyet oholo beHei ketiv. paris perisu vekabbil malchu shemaya bechulhu dargin deachidan beh. ucheden yada dekudesha berich hu shallit al kolla. ucheden bana mizbeach.

Uteren madbechan havu, begin dehacha itgeli leh deha kudesha berich hu shallit al kolla veyada chachma illaa, ma dela hava yada mikkadmat dena. uvana terin maddebchan chad ledarga deitgalya vechad ledarga deitkasya. ta chaze, dehachi hava bekadmita ketiv vayyiven sham mizbeach laAdonai hannire elav vegomer. ulevatar ketiv vayyiven sham mizbeach laAdonai setam vela ketiv hannire elav. vecholla raza dechachmeta ihu.

Ucheden itattar avraham middarga ledarga ad desalik ledargeh hada hu dichtiv vayyissa avram haloch venasoa hannegba. da darom dehu chulakeh deavraham. haloch venasoa darga batar darga ad desalik ledarom vetamman itkashshar kedka yeut vesalik ledargeh dedarom.
Kevan deitattar avraham bedargoy beara kaddisha veal (beara) bedarga kaddisha, keden ma ketiv vayhi raav baaretz. dela havu yade yedia lekarva legabbe dekudesha berich hu:

Vayhi raav baartz, dead kean la hava chela deal ara yahiv tukefa umezona al ara, begin dead la itkaddeshat (nusach acher ittaknat) vela kayyma bekiyyuma. kevan dechama avraham deha hahu chela dimmanna al ara la yahiv tukefa vechela kaddisha kidkachaze, keden vayyered avram mitzrayma lagur sham.

Mena yada avraham, dichtiv lezaracha natatti et haaretz hazzot. keden yada avraham deha ara la ittakna betikkuna kaddisha ella bedargin (yedian) kaddishin deyifkun minneh, ucheden yada avraham raza dechachmeta deara la tittakkan bikdusha ella kidamaran:

Uvedugema da bara guppa mearba yesodott esh veruach veappar umayim kegavvna dehu nishmatta lenishmatta neshama veruach veneppesh. mayim da dechar veda hu mayim metike dikdusha, veitt mayim hamearrim deinnun yetztzer hara. itt esha kaddisha nukeva veitt esha nucheraa esh zara, veal da ketiv veal yavo bechol ett el hakkodesh, deihi nukevta min yetztzer hara. ruach kaddisha ihu dechar. itt ruach mesoova da yetztzer hara shenneemar (Yeshayahu 14:29) ki mishoresh nachash yitztzu tzeppa. itt appar kaddisha vitt appar mesoova.

Veal do nishmatta deihi teshuva attekippatt beh behahu nachash letavra leh beshibuda ditteshuva vamshicha leh levatte chenesiyyott ulevatte midrashott, veinnun arba yesode mittepashtin lechv attevavn 84 128 133 dtlnt 657. (74 kan gillayon):

Vayyaavor avram baaretz ad mekom shechem. da be kenishta attar dediyyura dishchinta tamman kema deat amer, (Bereshit 48:22) vani nattatti lecha shechem echad, da shechinta deittechaze leh hoil veittekre tzaddik, deha tzedek lav diyyurah ella bahade tzaddik, veda hu ad mekom shechem. ad elon more ellu batte midrashott deolpin umorim tamman tora barabbim.

Vehakkenaani az baaretz. keden ittebassam veittetakkan yetztzer hara beguppa beal karcheh. desaggiin shemahan itt leh, uvegine chacha (ithaddar) idkar bishmahan saggiin. az baaretz vdoy veittekappeya behay, begin dichden ihu guppa bezimna dela itteavar minnih hahu nachash kol kacha, begin devekutta deguppa keden hakkenaani az baaretz, ammay ikre kenaani, deaschar guppa ledinin bishin.

Venishmatta kayyma behay alma (leittakna orchoy degufa) kedka yeutt begin lemizke bah, levattar kad nappekatt mehay alma i zachatt salka leatterah denappekatt mittamman dichtiv el mekom hammizbeach asher asa sham barishona uchetiv el hammakom asher haya sham oholo battechilla. oholo beHei.

Vehasheta ihi kayyma ben lesalka leela uven lenachatta letatta. (dichtiv) ben bett el uven haay. i zachatt salka el mekom hammizbeach, asher asa sham vegomer. man asa uman mizbeach. ella asher asa sham, da kudesha bericha hu. deihu avad tamman hay mizbeach veattekin lah al teresar avnin lemispar shivte bene yaakov asher haya devar Adonai elav lemor yisrael yihye shemecha vday.
Umizbeach da asa sham barishona kad ittebre alma illaa (illaa) temira lechol almin, umichael kahana rabba kaim umakriv alah karbanin denishmattin, kevan
159: Denishmatta salka tamman ma ketiv vayyikra sham avram boshom Adonai, nishmatta kare tamman veitztzerira bitztzerora dechayye.

Vechol da, i zakkaa behay alma leattekana guppa kedka yaott uleikkappeya (valeasepaya) tukepa dehahu latyay, ad deitteparsha minneh ma ketiv, vayhi riv ben roe mikne avram uven roe mikne lot (da yetzer hara), debchol yoma veyoma behay alma, innun sian umanhigi denishmatta, veinnun sian umanhigin deyetztzer hara, innun bekitruga mekatregin illen beillen, vechol shayypin deguppa betztzaara benayyhu ben nishmatta vehahu nachash deka maggichin kerava bechol yoma.

Ma ketiv vayyomer avram el lot. nishmatta ahaddera legabbe yetztzer hara veamar leh, al na tehi meriva beni uvenycha uven roay uven roecha, sitrin dili vesitrin dilacha. ki anashim achim anachnu, yitztzer tov veyetztzer hara kerevin da beda, da limina veda lismala.

Halo chol haaretz lepanycha hippared na mealay. saggiin chayyayvaya innun bealma, zil veshut abbatterayyhu veitteprash meimmi. im hasemol veemina vegomer. veochach leh veaik leh bechamma keravin deavid bahadeh bechol yoma, ad dichtiv vayyippardu ish meal achiv.

Kevan demitteparshin da min da ma ketiv, avram yoshev beeretz kenaan. itteyashvatt nishomotta beinnun tzaddikaya beyishuva tav bishlam. velot yashav beare hakkikkar, hahu latya mekatrega azil lekatrega uleittechabbera beattar dechayyayvaya tamman dichtiv vayyeehal ad sedom. ma ketiv battereh veanshe sedom raim vechataim laAdonai meod. tamman sharya veshavi diyyureh benayyhu leittechabbera behu leastaa lon uleovada lon. (veavraham beovadin tavin bitshuva beorayyta) (chaser) (sefer acher) beovadin bishin.

Kevan deishtearatt nishmatta bela mekatrega veittedche guppa mehahu zuhama, miyyad kudesha bericha hu ashre diyyureh bahadeh veyaritt achsanta illaa vetattaa, veitt leh nayycha ben tzaddikaya, vhahu latya ben innun rashiayay chatan bahadeh, ad dela hava purekana lechovayyhu.

Ma ketiv vayyishma avram ki nishba achiv. vayyishma avram da nishmatta deishtearatt bedachyu beguppa. ki nishba achiv, da yetztzer hara denishba ben innun chayyayvaya bechovin saggiin. vayyarek ett chanichav yelide vetto, illen innun tzaddikayay delaan beorayyta deinnun shayype deguppa zerizin lemehacha bahadeh 18 usholosh meott, illen 248 shayypin deguppa, vshivin, deraza denishmatta denappeka mittamman (ad kan). becholla izderaz lemehacha tamman legabbe innun chayyayvaya leattava lon (mechovoy) mechovehon.

Ma ketiv vyyirdof ad dan. radif abbatterayyhu veoda lon dino dehahu alma veonsha degehinnom, vela yahiv demichu leeneh bimama uvelelya ad deochach lon leinnun chayyayvin veattiv lon bitteyuveta legabbe kudesha bericha hu. ma ketiv vayyashev ett kol harchush, attiv lon bitteyuveta shelema kedka yeutt.

Vegam ett lot achiv vegomer. appillu lehahu yetztzer hara attekif bahadeh ad deachpeye beal karcheh (velo) veamtik leh kedka chaze. kolla attiv bitteyuveta shelematta kedka yeutt, begin dela ishtechach yemama velelya ad deochach lon uredaf lon al hahu chova dechavu ad detavu bitteyuveta shelematta kidkachazu.
